plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-select-skin

给 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的模型选择器换皮肤：胶囊芯片触发器 + 重做的下拉菜单。

## 截图

浅色主题：

![浅色主题下的模型选择器](docs/preview-light.png)

深色主题：

![深色主题下的模型选择器](docs/preview-dark.png)

## 效果

- **触发器**：胶囊芯片，含提供商彩点、`提供商 · 模型名`、思考档位标签
- **下拉菜单**：与官方弹层一致的半透明毛玻璃表面；分组标题显示提供商名 + 数量徽章
- **打开时自动定位**到当前选中的模型

## 安装

```bash
# 在 profile 的 node_modules 下软链本目录
ln -s /path/to/dsh-model-select-skin ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@local/dsh-model-select-skin
```

随后在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中插入插件行（本仓库已自带该补丁），重启 `dsh web` 即可。

## 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `client.js` | 浏览器端：注册低优先级席位，遮蔽官方选择器 |
| `index.js` | Host 端：仅承载 bundle 身份，`apply` 为空 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁，插入插件行 |
| `locale/` | 中英文案 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |
| `docs/` | 界面截图及其生成脚本 |

## 原理

`conversation.input.model` 是单槽席位，默认由官方 `client-ui-model-selection` 占据。
本插件以 **-1 优先级**注册同一个槽位，遮蔽官方入口（最低优先级先渲染）。

数据与提交**不重新实现**：组件通过 `modelDirectories` 服务读取按会话共享的目录
（与官方选择器、`/model` 弹窗同一份存储），选择走 `directory.select()`，即
官方的 `session/selectModel` 链路。因此在任何位置做的切换都处处可见。

禁用或卸载本插件即可恢复官方 UI。

## 关于截图

上方两张图是**真实运行中的 DSH Web GUI 截图**（由 `docs/capture-screenshot.mjs`
驱动无头 Chrome 抓取），不是示意图。

脚本通过 CDP 注入一个本地自签的浏览器 cookie 来访问 `127.0.0.1:3080`，
随后展开模型下拉并裁剪到菜单区域。用法与前置条件见脚本头部注释。

plugins.description: Session cost and billing metrics for the DSH Web GUI: what this conversation cost, what the cache saved, and whether the current hour is peak or off-peak. A companion to the shipped stats pills, never a duplicate of them.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-metrics

Session **cost and billing** metrics for the DSH Web GUI — what this conversation cost, what the
cache saved, and whether the current hour is peak or off-peak. Built as a companion to the shipped
stats pills, never a duplicate of them.

## Why

The shipped stats pills report tokens and context, and stop short of money. That leaves three
questions unanswered, and the obvious answer to each is a lie:

**A model with no rate card is not free.** An unpriceable provider reads `unpriced` and shows its
tokens; a genuinely free model ships a card of zeros and reads a real `$0.00`. The two must not
render alike — `unpriced` means *no card*, and an unpriced pair is never rendered as a number.

**A newly integrated provider arrives silently.** DSH reports usage per provider and model; rates are
configuration. Integrate a provider before its rates are entered — the case that happened with
OpenRouter — and every figure for it is missing with nothing on the page saying why. The session
detail names the pair it observed with no card, and the tokens it used.

**Peak pricing is invisible until it is a surprise.** DeepSeek bills peak and off-peak at different
rates, in the provider's own timezone. Whether *right now* is peak is not something a user should
have to derive.

## Agent Skills

Installing the plugin registers the **`session-metrics`** skill, so an agent can explain the figures
and reconfigure the rates without reading the source. Ask it what a session cost, whether a model is
priced, or how to add a rate card for a provider it has seen.

## Quick Start

The plugin installs into your DSH **profile** by link — it is not published to npm, so the clone is
the source. Both routes end with a **restart**.

### Option A — the script

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mrdhira/dsh-session-metrics.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-session-metrics
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-session-metrics
./install.sh                 # builds, registers in your profile, runs pnpm install
```

It accepts `--profile <dir>` to target a profile other than `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`, `--check` to
report what would change without writing anything, and `--remove` to unregister.

### Option B — the manual steps

**1. Clone it somewhere stable** (this path becomes your install path):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mrdhira/dsh-session-metrics.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-session-metrics
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-session-metrics
```

**2. Build it.** `pnpm install` runs the `prepare` script, which builds `lib/**` — the part DSH
actually loads. It is generated; never hand-edit it.

```bash
pnpm install
```

**3. Register it with your profile** — the dependency and the bundle name, with an absolute path:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-session-metrics": "link:/Users/<you>/.dsh/plugins/dsh-session-metrics"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "dsh-session-metrics"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**4. Install the link, then restart DSH:**

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && pnpm install
```

Nothing needs adding to `cordis.patch.yml`: the bundle declares its own Loader row.

> **Restart, don't reload.** The host half loads once per app process, so a host-side change needs a
> full quit and reopen (`⌘Q`, then reopen). A page reload does not pick it up. A client-side (UI)
> change needs the bundle toggled in the plugin manager.

### Verify it is really working

A strip should appear below the composer with `cost`, `saved` and a peak indicator. If it does not:

- `lib/v1/index.js` exists — if not, `pnpm install` did not finish building;
- the profile's `package.json` names `dsh-session-metrics` in **both** `dependencies` and
  `dsh.profile.bundles`;
- DSH was **restarted** after installing.

An `unpriced` chip means a working install with no matching rate card — not a failure. See
[Configure](#configure).

### Configure

**A fresh install needs no configuration.** Rate cards ship for `deepseek-account`,
`deepseek-official`, `netra-runtime` and `openrouter`, so the cost chip works immediately. OpenRouter
ships **only the models its own catalog marks free** (the `:free` suffix and the free-models router)
at zero rates; its paid models deliberately carry no card, because DSH reports no prices for them and
a fabricated rate is worse than a named gap.

Rates are edited in the GUI: **Plugins sidebar → `dsh-session-metrics`**. The same table can be set
in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: session-metrics
  name: dsh-session-metrics
  config:
    display: { currency: USD, primaryProvider: deepseek-account }
    budget: { sessionUsd: 5, warnAt: 0.75 }
    providers:
      - id: my-router
        models:
          - model: some/model
            rates: { flat: { cacheHit: 0.01, cacheMiss: 0.1, output: 0.25 } }
        billing: { windows: [] }      # no peak concept
```

Rates are USD per 1M tokens. A model takes **either** a `flat` row **or** a `peak` row with
`offPeak`. A provider with no `billing.windows` is flat and shows no peak chip.

> **A `providers:` list in your patch replaces the shipped cards** rather than adding to them. Pin your
> own providers and the OpenRouter free cards stop shipping with them — add a card for each pair you
> need, or let **Seen, unpriced** name the ones you missed.

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `display.currency` | `USD` | `USD` or `CNY` |
| `display.primaryProvider` | — | hides the provider chip when the session uses this provider |
| `display.chips` | all | which chips to show, and in what order: `peak`, `time`, `cost`, `saved`, `provider`, `budget` |
| `budget.sessionUsd` | off | per-session ceiling; omit to disable |
| `budget.warnAt` | `0.75` | fraction of the budget at which the strip warns |

The full rate-card format, the shipped cards and the reasoning behind them are in
[`docs/pricing.md`](docs/pricing.md).

## How it Works

Costs are derived from the Host's own `tokenUsage` projection — the same source the stats pills read
— so this plugin adds interpretation, not a second ledger. Cache savings compare each cache-hit token
against the rate that would have been paid on a miss, per the card in effect. Peak and off-peak
windows resolve in the provider's own timezone, holidays included, and the countdown is computed once
a minute while the detail view is open rather than on every render.

Two surfaces, one projection:

- **the strip**, below the composer: cost, cache savings, the peak state with your local time, the
  provider when it is not your configured primary, and budget progress;
- **the detail**, on click: the cost breakdown (cache-hit / miss / write / output), cache savings and
  blended rate, the rate window with a countdown, cost per step, cost per model when a session
  switched models, and the projections each figure came from.

The plugin deliberately does **not** render session token totals, cache-hit rate, context percentage,
turns, steps or tok/s — the shipped pills own those. [`docs/data-sources.md`](docs/data-sources.md)
records which projection feeds which figure, which is what keeps the two from drifting back into
duplication.

### Requirements

- **DSH** with the Web GUI, and a profile you can edit (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/`).
- **Node.js 22+** and **pnpm** to build from source. The built artifact needs nothing extra at
  runtime.

### Development

```bash
pnpm install                  # deps + build (prepare)
pnpm run build                # rebuild lib/**
pnpm test                     # 111 tests: 105 pass, 6 skipped without a session log
pnpm run typecheck            # three projects: host, browser half, tests
pnpm run test:fast            # host logic only — the quick loop
pnpm run test:dom             # the UI half under jsdom
DSH_SESSION_LOG=<path>.jsonl.zstd pnpm run test:replay   # replays a real session
```

```
src/host/*.ts         host half: config schema, projection, ledger, pricing  -> lib/v1/index.js
src/client/index.cts  browser half: strip, detail panel, pricing page        -> lib/v1/client.js
types/dsh.d.ts        the DSH surfaces this plugin uses (the app ships no .d.ts)
build.mjs             esbuild: ESM host half, CJS browser half + loader h

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-deepsearch

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-deepsearch)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-deepsearch)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/github-SeaViod%2Fdsh--plugin--deepsearch-181717?logo=github)](https://github.com/SeaViod/dsh-plugin-deepsearch)

Switch DSH's built-in `web_search` between the **DeepSeek Search API** (`POST /v1/tools/search`) and DSH's default account search — with automatic fallback, a settings page, a sidebar switch and a model-facing tool.

English | [中文说明](README.zh.md)

- **ON (`deepseek-api`)** — the built-in `web_search` tool is served by the DeepSeek Search API. This is a paid API: successful requests are billed by DeepSeek; check the current pricing in your DeepSeek console before enabling it.
- **OFF (`builtin`)** — the default DSH route: server-side account search (one search consumes one model turn).
- Switching is **immediate** and survives restarts: the mode is persisted in `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-mode.json`.
- **It never makes search unavailable.** With no key, a 401, a network error, or 429/5xx retries exhausted, the provider falls back to the previous (or another available) search provider and reports the reason in `lastError`.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — only `node:` builtins and the global `fetch`. No build step.
- Settings page and sidebar switch are localized in **English and Chinese**.

## What it does

The plugin has two halves that work together:

| Half | File | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` | Registers the model tool `deepsearch`, registers a search provider (default id `deepseek-search-api`), routes `web.searchProviderId` on/off, exposes four HTTP routes under `/deepsearch/`, and resolves the API key. |
| Browser | `client.js` | Hand-written bundle loaded through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)`: the settings tab and the sidebar footer switch. |

`cordis.patch.yml` is the bundle patch: a `dsh plugin add` or plugin-market install puts the package into the profile's `node_modules` (recorded in the profile `package.json` under `dsh.profile.bundles`), and the bundle layer applies this patch at boot — you do not need to edit the profile patch by hand.

## Three entry points

| Entry point | Where | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| Settings page | **Settings → Built-in plugins → DeepSeek Search** | switch, status details, endpoint test, API key editor |
| Sidebar switch | Footer of the left sidebar | one-click toggle that shows the current route (`API` / `builtin`) |
| Model tool | `deepsearch` (`status` / `on` / `off` / `search` / `fetch` / `check`) | toggle the route or run a search from a conversation |

## Install

### From the plugin market

Search for **dsh-plugin-deepsearch** (or "DeepSeek Search") in the DSH plugin market and install it. The storefront uses the package's `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the host half is registered automatically. After installing, the new settings tab appears under **Settings → Built-in plugins → DeepSeek Search**; a browser page reload may be needed the first time so the client bundle is picked up.

### From the command line

```pwsh
# Install into the default profile
dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-deepsearch

# Or target a profile explicitly: `web` for a `dsh web` server
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-deepsearch
```

Installing for the **Desktop app** uses the desktop profile / the in-app plugin market UI (the Desktop app keeps its profile under its own DSH home; no user-home path has to be typed by hand). The plugin's browser half declares `dsh.client.platform: "web"`, which is what the desktop shell also loads.

If you are installing from a checkout rather than the registry, `npm pack` the folder and `dsh plugin add` the resulting tarball.

### Upgrading from 0.1.x

0.1.x had no bundle patch; it was installed by hand with one insert row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: deepsearch
      name: dsh-plugin-deepsearch
```

0.2.0 ships `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml` at the package root). A `dsh plugin add` or plugin-market install does **not** write an insert row into the profile patch: it installs the package into the profile's `node_modules`, records it in the profile's `package.json` under `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the bundle layer applies the package's own `cordis.patch.yml` at boot. **Remove the old hand-written insert row before installing 0.2.0 as a bundle** — a leftover hand-written row plus a bundle install would load the plugin twice. Mode and key files under `$DSH_HOME` are kept, so the switch state and the key file survive the upgrade.

The profile name depends on the client: use `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-deepsearch` for a `dsh web` server; the Desktop app uses the `desktop` profile and its plugin-market UI. Do not type a full profile path — let `dsh plugin` resolve it.

### Uninstall

Remove the package from the profile (or uninstall it from the plugin market). The plugin does not add other files to the profile. The state file `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-mode.json`, the diagnostics file `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-diag.json` and the optional key file `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-key.txt` can be deleted, or left in place if you plan to reinstall.

## Configuration

Configuration is read from the `config` block of the plugin's entry in the profile patch, and is normalized so that invalid values fall back to the defaults instead of throwing:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: deepsearch
      name: dsh-plugin-deepsearch
      config:
        apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
        count: 8
        retryCount: 1
```

All keys are optional. The table below matches the host config schema; the `config` block is also what a bundle install can carry.

| Key | Default | Normalisation / meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | `''` | API key given inline. String, trimmed; empty means "unset". Not recommended: it stays in the patch file. Never echoed back by any route. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `'DEEPSEEK_API_KEY'` | Name of the credentials reference / environment variable to resolve. Must match `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/`, otherwise the default is used. |
| `baseURL` | `'https://api.deepseek.com'` | API base URL. Trimmed; must parse as an `http(s)` URL; trailing slashes are stripped. |
| `searchPath` | `'/v1/tools/search'` | Search endpoint path (appended to `baseURL`). Trimmed, forced to start with `/`; a `?` or `#` rejects the value; empty falls back to the default. |
| `fetchPath` | `'/v1/tools/fetch'` | Page-fetch endpoint path (same rules as `searchPath`). |
| `keyFile` | `''` | Key file for the file-based key. `''` means `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-key.txt`; `~/...` expands to the home directory; a relative path resolves under `$DSH_HOME`; anything else is used as an absolute path. |
| `count` | `8` | Number of search results. Integer, clamped to 1..50. |
| `needContent` | `false` | Ask the search API for page content (direct `deepsearch search` calls only). Only a strict `true` enables it. |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Timeout per HTTP attempt. Integer, clamped to 1000..120000. |
| `retryCount` | `1` | Extra attempts after the first one (on 408/429/5xx). Integer, clamped to 0..3. |
| `retryDelayMs` | `1200` | Delay between retry attempts. Integer, clamped to 100..10000. |
| `maxFetchChars` | `20000` | Maximum characters returned by `fetch`/the `search` tool when content is requested. Integer, clamped to 1000..200000. |
| `providerId` | `'deepseek-search-api'` | Search provider id to register. Must match `/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/` and must not collide with an existing provider, except for the plugin's own re-registration. |
| `fallbackProvider` | `''` | Preferred fallback provider id used when switching OFF. Empty means auto-detect (the previously active provider, then the first available provider that is not ours). |
| `fallbackOnError` | `true` | When the Search API call fails, fall back to another provider. Only a strict `true` enables it. |
| `language` | `'auto'` | `auto` / `en` / `zh`. `auto` resolves from `DSH_LANGUAGE`, `DSH_LOCALE`, `LANG`, `LC_ALL` (Chinese locales map to `zh`, everything else to `en`). |
| `checkQuery` | `'DeepSeek'` | Query used by the "tes

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：上下文超过 45% 且静默 3 分钟时自动压缩会话历史
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-compact

DeepSeek Harness 插件：**上下文占用超过 30%、且对话 3 分钟没有动静时，自动压缩会话历史。**

阈值、静默时长、巡检间隔、冷却时间都可配置。

> **EN** — A DSH host plugin that compacts a session automatically once its context
> usage passes a threshold (30% by default) **and** the conversation has been idle
> for a while (3 minutes by default). Zero runtime dependencies; it only decides
> *when*, and delegates the actual summarization to the official
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` backend via `/compact`.

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 自带的自动压缩只在“回合进行中、跑到模型上下文阈值（默认 80%）”时才触发。
长会话往往在回合结束时停在 60%~80% 之间，之后你放着不动，下一句话照样要带着
一坨旧历史进请求：首 token 慢、贵，还容易在再聊几轮后直接顶到上限。

这个插件补上“空闲期”这一段：只要某个会话**已经静默够久**，且**上下文占用已过线**，
它就在后台把旧历史压成一条 checkpoint，等你回来时上下文是干净的。

## 判定规则

每个巡检周期（默认 15s）对每个存活会话依次检查：

| 条件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `agent.status === "idle"` | 回合正在跑时**绝不**介入，不和进行中的对话抢状态 |
| 静默 ≥ `idleMs` | 会话日志事件、agent 状态变化、收件箱投递都会刷新“最后活跃时间” |
| 上下文 ≥ `thresholdRatio` | 取 token-meter 的上下文投影（与界面显示的百分比同源） |
| 距离上次尝试 ≥ `cooldownMs` | 成功、失败、跳过都计入冷却，避免反复打扰模型 |
| 不在压缩中 | 单个会话同时只允许一次自动压缩 |

命中后调用官方压缩链路，把可压缩的历史压成一条 checkpoint。压缩本身产生的事件
会刷新活跃时间，所以不会连环触发。

## 安装

### 方式一：从 tgz 安装（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:C:/Plugins/dsh-auto-compact-0.1.0.tgz
```


### 方式二：从源码（GitHub）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/fpm0312/dsh-auto-compact.git
cd dsh-auto-compact
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:$PWD/dsh-auto-compact-0.1.2.tgz"
```

PowerShell 里最后一行写成：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:$((Get-Location).Path)\dsh-auto-compact-0.1.2.tgz"
```

开发调试可以直接用 `link:` 挂目录（改动免重装，但需要重启应用让宿主重新 import）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:$PWD"
```

### 方式三：手工挂载（等价）

1. 把本包放进 profile 的依赖里（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`）：
   `"dsh-auto-compact": "file:C:/Plugins/dsh-auto-compact-0.1.0.tgz"`
2. 在同一个文件的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `"dsh-auto-compact"`。
3. 在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`。

本包自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch`），安装后会把 `auto-compact`
一行插进配置树，不需要手改 `cordis.patch.yml`。桌面端的 profile 监听会在
`package.json` / patch 变化时热重载插件树；否则重启一次应用即可。

## 配置

配置写在插件行上（profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，或直接用上面的 `config` 段覆盖）：

```yaml
- id: auto-compact
  name: dsh-auto-compact
  config:
    thresholdRatio: 0.30     # 上下文占用阈值（占模型上下文窗口比例）
    idleMs: 180000           # 静默多久算“没动静”（毫秒）
    pollMs: 15000            # 巡检间隔（毫秒）
    cooldownMs: 300000       # 两次尝试之间的最小间隔（毫秒）
    minTokens: 0             # 低于这个绝对 token 数不压缩
    compactTimeoutMs: 600000 # 单次压缩超时
    dryRun: false            # true = 只记录“本该压缩”，不真的压
    statusFile: true         # 心跳状态文件；false 关闭，或给绝对路径
    via: auto                # auto | service | command
    verbose: true            # 是否输出 info 日志
```


### `via` 是什么

压缩后端挂在**每个 agent preset 的隔离作用域**里，宿主平面拿不到 `ctx.compaction`。
插件按以下顺序找通道：

1. `service`：`agent.ctx.get("compaction")` 能拿到就直接调 `compactNow()`；
2. `command`：拿不到就执行内置的 `/compact` 命令 —— 同一条官方压缩链路，
   会在会话日志里留下 `command/run` + `command/done`，界面上可见。

`auto`（默认）先试 1 再退 2；`service` / `command` 可以强制只走某一条。

## 可观测性

- **心跳文件**：默认 `~/.dsh/auto-compact.status.json`，每次巡检后刷新。里面有每个
  会话的 `totalTokens` / `contextWindow` / `ratio` / `reason` / `lastAction`，
  一眼能看出“为什么这次没压”。
- **命令**：`/autocompact` 查看当前会话的占用与判定；`/autocompact now` 立即评估一次
  （跳过静默等待，但仍受阈值与冷却约束）。
- **日志**：`[auto-compact]` 前缀，info 级汇报压缩结果，warn 级汇报真故障；
  “agent 忙 / 被取消”这类正常竞争只记 info。

## 设计取舍

- **只做决策，不重写压缩**：真正的摘要、写 checkpoint、替换 surface 全部交给
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`，插件只负责“什么时候该压”。
- **零 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖**：安装成 tgz 后不需要解析宿主的 peer 依赖，宿主升级
  也不会因为类型/内部实现变化把插件带崩。
- **空闲优先**：绝不压缩正在跑的回合。压缩是重活（要调一次模型），空闲期做最划算。
- **百分比与界面同源**：优先读 token-meter 的 `contextPressure` 投影
  （`pressureTokens + surfaceTokens - sampledSurfaceTokens`），拿不到才退回
  `measure().totalTokens` 估算。

## 开发

```bash
node --test test/auto-compact.test.mjs   # 16 个用例：决策矩阵 + 假宿主集成
node --check lib/index.js
npm pack                                  # 产出 tgz
```


`test/` 里用假宿主驱动 `apply()`，覆盖：静默判定、阈值边界、运行中不介入、
事件刷新计时、冷却、dryRun、命令兜底、投影优先、心跳文件、`/autocompact`。

## 已知限制

- 只对**空闲**会话生效；回合进行中的压力压缩仍然交给 `compaction-basic` 自己的阈值
  （默认 80%）。两者互补，不冲突。
- 压缩会真实调用一次模型（摘要），会计费；`cooldownMs` 就是为此存在的。
- 如果 profile 里根本没有挂载任何压缩后端，`/compact` 也不存在，插件会如实报
  `missing` 并在心跳文件里留痕，不会静默失败。

plugins.description: DSH 侧栏网页预览：在右侧栏直接打开本地开发服务器或任意网址，不用跳出去开外部浏览器。In-sidebar web preview for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-preview

在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏里直接预览网页，不用跳出 DSH 去开外部浏览器。

Preview web pages inside the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar — no external browser window needed.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.1%2B-blue.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0284c7.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

> 装不上、报错、或者行为和文档对不上，直接发邮件到 **1992335297@qq.com**，比开 Issue 更快被看到。

---

![右侧栏网页预览](docs/preview.png)

> 图为界面示意，按插件 `lib/client.js` 的地址栏与 iframe 布局渲染，不是运行截图。可用 `node scripts/make-screenshots.mjs` 重新生成（源码在 `scripts/demo/preview.html`）。

## 它解决什么问题

写完前端要验证效果，标准流程是切到浏览器、开新标签、输地址、再切回来。真机上窗口一多就找不着北。DSH 的右侧栏本来就是文件预览的地盘，把网页也放进去，视线不用离开对话。

`dsh-web-preview` 给右侧栏加一个「网页预览」标签页：输入地址、回车，页面就在侧栏里跑起来。

## 用法

1. 点右侧栏 tab 条上的添加按钮，在引导页里选 **网页预览**。
2. 在地址栏输入 `localhost:5173` 或 `https://example.com`，回车。
3. 地址栏右侧三个按钮：重新加载、在外部浏览器打开、复制地址。

地址会自动补协议：`localhost:5173` 走 `http://`，裸域名走 `https://`。显式写了协议就按你写的来。

## 实现方式

走 DSH 官方的侧栏扩展点，不自绘面板、不覆盖既有 UI：

- 类型注册：`ctx.sidebarRightTabs.register({ id, kind, patterns, priority, title, guide })`
- 正文注册：`ctx.slots.register({ name: 'sidebar.right.pane.tab', key })`
- 导航：`ctx.sidebarRight.openResource('dsh-resource://web/<encodeURIComponent(url)>')`

每个预览地址是一个独立的资源 tab，同一地址重复打开会聚焦已有 tab，不会堆一堆重复页。tab 标题取目标站点的 host。

宿主侧只提供一个只读健康检查 `/api/web-preview/health`，不读文件、不落盘、没有对外网络请求。

## 安全边界

- iframe 只接受 `http` / `https`，其它协议直接拒绝。
- 拒绝把 DSH 自身的 origin 当作预览目标，避免把 DSH 页面嵌进自己造成同源脚本互扰。
- 不注入任何脚本到被预览的页面，不读取页面内容，不上报任何数据。
- 预览页运行在 iframe 的独立文档上下文里；父页面不获得它的 DOM。

## 已知限制

- 跨域页面无法被父页面读取 DOM，所以这一版只能「看」，不能「批注」。
- 拒绝承载体 X-Frame-Options / CSP `frame-ancestors` 的站点会白屏，这类站点请用地址栏右侧的 ↗ 打开到外部浏览器。
- 需要登录态的页面在侧栏里可能没有 cookie，取决于目标站点的 SameSite 策略。
- 尚未注册模型工具，目前由用户手动输入地址。

## 路线图

批注功能（指向页面元素、显示标签/尺寸/颜色/字体、点击就地下评论、批注回填输入框）二期实现。跨域 iframe 拿不到内部 DOM，二期改为宿主侧接管浏览器：Playwright 打开页面、CDP 推画面、坐标回传、`document.elementFromPoint` 取元素、注入批注覆盖层。

## 开发

```
lib/index.js         宿主侧：健康检查路由 + URL 规范化
lib/client.js        客户端侧：tab 类型注册、正文（地址栏 + iframe）
scripts/verify.mjs   自检
```

```bash
node scripts/verify.mjs
```

覆盖包元数据、patch 结构、客户端语法与依赖声明、同源防护、四类 URL 规范化用例、路由注册与健康检查、非法路由。共 14 项。

## 安装

### 一条命令

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:nubeslove/dsh-web-preview"
```

然后在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `"dsh-web-preview"`，重启 DSH。

实测 pnpm 11.9 从 GitHub 直接拉取，3.9 秒装完。插件是纯 JS，没有构建步骤，也没有任何运行时依赖。

### 本地开发

自己改代码时用 link 指向工作副本：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-preview"
```

路径含空格时手工处理：在 `profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-web-preview": "link:E:/path/to/dsh-web-preview"`，在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 追加 `"dsh-web-preview"`，并在 `profiles/desktop/node_modules/` 下建指向本目录的 Junction，然后重启 DSH。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

## 反馈与联系 / Feedback & Contact

遇到 bug、安装失败、行为和文档不一致，或者想要某个功能，都可以直接发邮件。

**邮箱：1992335297@qq.com**

邮件里带上这三样，定位会快很多：

- 插件版本（`package.json` 里的 `version`）
- DSH 版本（`dsh --version`）
- 报错的完整文字或截图

也可以在 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/nubeslove/dsh-web-preview/issues) 提，但邮件更快。

plugins.description: Background sidecar subagents for the DeepSeek Harness: unique names, separate cwd/git-worktree spaces, review-on-demand results.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidecar

Fire focused subagents in the background with unique names and separate spaces,
then review each result — task, answer and evidence trail, plus the full
transcript on demand — on your own schedule. **Separate plugin**: no shared state with `dsh-autocontinue`
(continuation/restarts) or the `dsh-update` updater.

## Commands and tools

```sh
/sidecar <task>                              # auto name (sidecar-1, -2, ...), parent cwd
/sidecar --name alpha <task>                 # unique name, pinned as the child session title
/sidecar --cwd /tmp/alpha-space <task>       # separate working directory
/sidecar --worktree --name wt-fix <task>     # isolated git worktree + branch sidecar/wt-fix
/sidecar list                                # running sidecars: name, id, age, cwd
/sidecar result <id>                         # read and consume a stored result now
/sidecar log <id>                            # full child transcript on demand
/sidecar cancel <id>                         # interrupt one
```

Multiple sidecars run concurrently up to the subagents service cap
(`maxActiveSubagents`, default 8). Each gets a unique name (requested names are
suffixed `-2`, `-3`, ... if taken), a distinct child session id, and its title
pinned to the name so the GUI list is unambiguous. They share the parent cwd by
default; use `--cwd` for a separate workspace or `--worktree` for a real
filesystem/branch isolation. Worktrees start from `HEAD` — uncommitted parent
changes are intentionally not visible there.

Model-facing tools (used when the parent chooses to review):

- `sidecar_result` — `{ id }` returns the stored review body and removes it
  from the queue.
- `sidecar_list` — lists stored results waiting for review.

## Delivery: notice, not a queued user message

The child is spawned through `ctx.subagents.startActivation()` with
`delivery: 'caller'`; its prompt forbids `send_message` and further delegation.

When it finishes, the plugin:

1. stores the full result at
   `~/.dsh/sidecar/results/<parent>/<child>.json`;
2. calls `agent.inject(notice)` — a **next-step notice with no wake**. This is
   not `followup`: it does not create a queued user message and does not start a
   turn. A running parent sees it at its next step; an idle parent sees it when
   it next runs. The notice says only that the result is stored and that
   `sidecar_result` will return it;
3. never injects the full result into the transcript. The parent reviews by
   calling `sidecar_result` (or the user runs `/sidecar result <id>`), which
   returns the result as a **tool result** and consumes the file.

The stored review is deliberately compact:

- the **complete task** the sidecar was given (so the parent knows what the
  result is for),
- the **final answer**,
- a **compact evidence trail**: every tool call and its result, in order
  (capped at 8 KB), and
- the **child session id** with a pointer to `sidecar_log`.

The child's complete session log — including workspace instructions, reasoning
and every step — stays on disk. `sidecar_log` (or `/sidecar log <id>`) returns
it on demand. Pushing the full raw log into the parent by default would bury the
useful task/answer under pages of workspace boilerplate, so it is opt-in.

If the parent closes before ever seeing the notice, the file persists; the next
time that parent agent is created (session reopened or resumed) the notice is
injected again. `sidecar_list` is the discovery path if the notice was already
consumed or missed.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kenjoe41/dsh-sidecar
# or pin a release
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kenjoe41/dsh-sidecar#v0.4.0
```

For a local checkout, link it instead; a linked install needs
`node_modules/@deepseek-ai/{dsh-llm,dsh-tools}` shims so the profile's peers
resolve. Reload or restart the profile after installing.

plugins.description: DSH GUI control: one-click hard refresh of the web UI and restart of the Harness host (sidebar entries + settings status panel). · DeepSeek Harness 界面控制插件
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gui-control

给 DSH 的 Web GUI 加两个控制动作：**强刷界面** 与 **重启 Harness**，三处入口共用同一套实现。

- **会话头右上角**：两个 24px 图标按钮，排在官方那三个按钮（在应用中打开 / 会话日志「更多」/ 右栏展开）
  左侧，中间多留 8px 空隙。图标态没有文字，语义在 `aria-label` / `title` 上；重启武装时图标转红并在
  下方浮出提示气泡（绝对定位，不推动这一排）。
- **侧边栏底部**：两个一键入口（展开态是「图标 + 文字」整行，收起态是 32px 图标按钮）。
- **设置 → 界面控制**：运行状态（插件版本 / Host pid / 已运行时长 / 平台 / Profile）、两个动作和说明。

三处入口调用的是同一对函数（`hardReload()` / `restartHarness()`），不存在第二套实现。

## 两个动作分别解决什么

| | 强刷界面 | 重启 Harness |
|---|---|---|
| 做什么 | 清空 `CacheStorage`、注销 Service Worker，然后整页重载，重新拉取并执行每个客户端插件 bundle | 通过 DSH Desktop 的 preload 桥（`window.dshDesktop.restartHarness` → 主进程 IPC `harness:restart`）重启 Host 进程，然后重新加载页面 |
| 什么时候用 | 改了客户端插件（`lib/client.js`）没生效；界面卡在旧的插件列表；样式错乱 | 改了 Host 侧（node 半侧）代码；安装/升级了插件；需要重新加载 Profile |
| 影响 | 只重载这一页，Host 进程不动 | Host 重启，**正在运行的任务会被中断** |
| 可用范围 | 任意载体（桌面端 / 浏览器） | 仅 DSH Desktop 桌面窗口（浏览器里按钮禁用并说明原因） |

重启是破坏性动作，所以做成**两步确认**：第一次点击只「武装」（设置页/侧边栏里按钮变成「确认重启？」并转红，会话头里图标转红并浮出提示），4 秒内再点一次才真的执行，超时自动取消。不用原生 `confirm()`——它会阻塞渲染进程。

## 为什么强刷不是 Ctrl+F5 的严格等价物

页面脚本无法改变文档自身的 cache 模式，所以浏览器层面的「硬刷新」标志拿不到。但本 GUI 会陈旧的三处来源都被覆盖了：

1. `CacheStorage` 里的缓存条目（逐个删除）；
2. 残留的 Service Worker（逐个 `unregister()`）；
3. 客户端模块 factory 的进程内记忆（整页重载即清空）。

插件 bundle 的 URL 自带 `rev=`，Host 侧按 revision 缓存字节，因此重载后拿到的一定是最新产物——这也意味着通常「重载」就够，清缓存是保险。

## 安装

三种方式效果相同（都会写进 `profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`）：

### 1. 从 GitHub 仓库装（推荐）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ccccwwwxx/dsh-gui-control
```

`lib/client.js` 已随仓库提交，安装时无需构建。

### 2. 从 Release 预构建包装（免构建、免 `allowBuilds` 授权）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ccccwwwxx/dsh-gui-control/releases/latest/download/dsh-gui-control.tgz
```

### 3. GUI / 本地目录（开发时用）

**设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，填本地目录的绝对路径；插件页的安装动作就是 `pluginManager.installBundle`：
先在 `.generations/staging` 里装好、逐层校验，再提升为一代（`dsh-gui-control+<version>+<hash>`）并写进 profile manifest。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-gui-control`。

### 安装之后

- **首次安装**：客户端半侧随 HMR 直接生效（会话头右上角与侧边栏底部立刻出现两个入口）；没出现就点一次「强刷」。
- **升级安装**：插件管理器会报告 `application: "restart-required"`——新一代 Host 代码要重启才加载，
  正好用插件的「重启」按钮（或菜单里的 Restart Harness）完成，然后页面会重新加载。

## 开发

```powershell
npm run build     # src/client/*.js -> lib/client.js（注入 lib/text.js 的文案）
npm run verify    # 15 项自验：产物新鲜度、bundle 契约、槽位注册、渲染、三处入口的动作、文案对齐
```

`lib/client.js` 是**构建产物**，不要手改：改 `src/client/*.js` 或 `lib/text.js`，然后 `npm run build`。
`npm run verify` 会把重新构建的结果与已提交的 `lib/client.js` 逐字节比对，忘了 build 会直接失败。

### 目录

```
cordis.patch.yml        Loader 条目（插入 dsh-gui-control）
lib/index.js            node 半侧：只读状态 RPC（版本 / pid / 运行时长）
lib/text.js             zh / en 文案，唯一维护处
lib/client.js           构建产物（window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...) 格式）
src/build-client.mjs    拼接 + 注入文案
src/client/00-shared.js 常量、RPC、强刷/重启动作、样式
src/client/10-footer.js 侧边栏两个入口
src/client/15-header.js 会话头右上角两个图标按钮（两步确认 + 提示气泡）
src/client/20-settings.js 设置页区块
src/client/90-apply.js  注册槽位
scripts/verify.mjs      自验
```

### 槽位契约

| 槽 | 类型 | 注册项 | owner 传入 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conversation.session.header.utilities` | list / session | `gui-control-header-refresh`(-40)、`gui-control-header-restart`(-39) | — |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | list / root | `gui-control-refresh`(71)、`gui-control-restart`(72) | `{ wide }` |
| `settings.section` | list / root | `gui-control`(96) | — |

会话头的 order 用负数是为了排在官方那三个按钮左侧（`open-in-app` 是 -10，会话日志「更多」默认 0）；
`restart` 带 `margin-right:8px`，在容器自带的 8px gap 之外再多留一点空隙。

样式只用主题变量（`--dsw-alias-*`）并带兜底值，类名固定 `dsh-gui-` 前缀，不依赖构建哈希。

## 已知边界

- **Host 侧没有、也不该有「重启自己」的口子**：那是桌面壳的进程监督职责。浏览器版没有重启能力，按钮会禁用并说明。
- **强刷不等价于浏览器的硬刷新标志**（见上）。
- **状态里的「Host 已运行时长」是模块加载时刻起算**，不是操作系统进程的创建时间；两者在正常启动下几乎相同。
- 重启会中断正在运行的任务与工具调用，这是 Host 重启的固有代价，不是插件的选择。

plugins.description: Peak and off-peak pricing awareness for DeepSeek Harness: a live composer badge with the time left in the current window, converted to your timezone. Community plugin, not official.
plugins.readme_text:
**DeepSeek charges half price outside peak hours. This tells you when that is.** COMMUNITY PLUGIN  ·  NOT OFFICIAL  ·  MIT  ·  DSH 0.2.x

[Install](#install)  ·  [Use](#use)  ·  [How it works](#how-it-works)  ·  [Timezones](#timezones)  ·  [FAQ](#faq)

> **This is a community plugin, not an official DeepSeek product.** > > Peak Hours is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, > or supported by DeepSeek AI, and it is not part of DeepSeek Harness. DeepSeek > Harness and DeepSeek are names and marks of their respective owners. ## Why this exists DeepSeek's API has two prices. Off-peak costs half of the peak rate. The windows are written in UTC, on a Beijing calendar, in a paragraph on the pricing page. That is the correct way to define the policy and a terrible way to read it from Tel Aviv at 17:35. You do the arithmetic in your head, guess, or notice the difference on the invoice later. Peak Hours puts one badge in the composer bar. It says **Peak** or **Off-peak** and how long the current window has left. Click it and you get the day as a clock face, the schedule in your own timezone, and the exact moment the price changes. | | Peak | Off-peak | | --- | --- | --- | | Rate | full price | **half price** | | UTC | 01:00–04:00, 06:00–10:00 | every other hour | | Beijing | 09:00–12:00, 14:00–18:00 | nights, weekends, holidays | | Days | Monday to Friday, not a Chinese public holiday | weekends and holidays, all day | The plugin answers one question: which column am I in, and for how much longer. ## What it looks like

Light and dark. The 24-hour face is your local day, with every peak window in amber and a marker for now.

The badge is small enough to ignore while you type. The ring drains over the current window, so a glance tells you whether you have minutes or hours. | | Off-peak | Peak | | --- | --- | --- | | Badge accent | green | amber | | Ring | drains over the off-peak stretch | drains over the peak window | | Panel chip | half rate | peak rate | ## Install **Requires [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 0.2.x** (tested on `0.2.1-rc.1`). Desktop and the Web UI are both supported. The repository is the install unit. The package inside it is `dsh-peak-hours`; the spec you paste is the GitHub address. ### 1. From the Plugins page (recommended) 1. Open the sidebar and choose **Plugins**. 2. Install a plugin and paste: ```text github:Adolanium/dsh-peak-hours ``` 3. Install it. The bundle is enabled by default. 4. Refresh the DeepSeek Harness window (`Ctrl+R` / `Cmd+R`). The browser half loads lazily, so the badge appears after a reload. No build permission is needed. The package ships plain JavaScript, has no `prepare` script, and has no runtime dependencies. ### 2. With the `dsh` CLI ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Adolanium/dsh-peak-hours ``` `dsh` appends the bundle to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` because the package declares `dsh.bundle`. Start DeepSeek Harness afterwards, then refresh the window. Pin the install to this release: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Adolanium/dsh-peak-hours#v0.1.0 ``` Remove it with: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-peak-hours ``` ### 3. From a checkout (development) ```sh git clone https://github.com/Adolanium/dsh-peak-hours.git cd dsh-peak-hours ./scripts/install-dev.sh ``` That links the checkout into `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules` and adds the plugin's Loader entry to the profile patch, with a timestamped backup. Undo it with `./scripts/uninstall-dev.sh`. > The profile reloads configuration live, so the Host half activates without a > restart. The browser half is loaded lazily: refresh the window for code > changes. ## Use Open any session. The badge sits in the composer bar, just left of the model selector. **The badge** shows the current window and the time left. It recalculates every second, so it never drifts. **The panel** opens on click: - the countdown, to the second; - a 24-hour face of your local day, with peak windows in amber and a marker for now; - the next change, for example `Peak starts today at 09:00`; - the full schedule converted into your timezone, and the reason for today (`Weekday`, `Weekend`, or a holiday name); - your timezone with its current offset, and the same moment in Beijing. `Esc` or a click outside closes it. The badge keeps ticking while the panel is closed. Below one hour the panel counts seconds. Above one hour it counts minutes, which is what you want when the answer is "two days". ## How it works ```text your clock │ ├─ Beijing calendar: weekday? public holiday? ├─ UTC windows: 01:00–04:00, 06:00–10:00 ▼ countdown + local-day arcs ``` Three rules keep it honest: 1. **The policy is evaluated where it is written.** Peak windows are UTC instants. Whether a day is a peak day is a Beijing calendar question, so the plugin asks the Beijing calendar, not your `Date` object. A Friday 23:00 in Los Angeles is a Saturday in Beijing, and the badge says so. 2. **The rendering is yours.** Those instants are formatted with `Intl` in your own zone. Daylight saving time is handled by the platform, not by fixed offsets, and a 23 or 25 hour local day still draws correctly on the face. 3. **No zone, no pretending.** If the runtime cannot resolve a timezone, the plugin falls back to Beijing time and labels the panel `Beijing time · fallback`. It never presents a guess as your local time. The badge is one registration in `conversation.input.right`. It uses the Harness theme tokens for every surface and text color, so it follows your theme, including custom ones. There is no Host route, no network request, and no state written to disk. ## Timezones Peak windows are the same instants everywhere. The clock times are not: | Your zone | Peak hours, local time | | --- | --- | | Beijing (UTC+8) | 09:00–12:00 · 14:00–18:00 | | Jerusalem (UTC+3) | 04:00–07:00 · 09:00–13:00 | | Kolkata (UTC+5:30) | 06:30–09:30 · 11:30–15:30 | | Los Angeles (UTC-7) | 18:00–21:00 · 23:00–03:00 | The second Los Angeles window crosses local midnight. The panel prints it as `23:00–03:00` and the day face shows the part that falls inside today, because that is what your clock does. The timezone comes from the operating system or browser. It is read when the badge appears, so after a flight or a manual timezone change, refresh the window. ## The holiday calendar Chinese public holidays are off-peak all day. The plugin ships the official 2026 schedule from [国办发明电〔2025〕7号](https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2025/issue_12406/202511/content_7048922.html): | Holiday | Dates | | --- | --- | | New Year's Day | 1 to 3 January | | Spring Festival | 15 to 23 February | | Qingming | 4 to 6 April | | Labour Day | 1 to 5 May | | Dragon Boat | 19 to 21 June | | Mid-Autumn | 25 to 27 September | | National Day | 1 to 7 October | China designates 14 February, 28 February, 9 May, 20 September, and 10 October in 2026 as make-up workdays. They fall on a Saturday or Sunday, so the Monday to Friday policy leaves them off-peak. The plugin does not treat them as working days. The State Council publishes the next year's schedule each November. When it does, add the spans to `HOLIDAYS` in [`lib/client.js`](lib/client.js) and update the count in the test. Until then, a date outside the table follows the weekday rule. ## What it does not do - It does not change what you pay or which model you use. - It does not call the DeepSeek API, and it does not store your usage. - It does not add a rou

plugins.description: Vendor marks in the DeepSeek Harness model picker: the provider's own model catalog and logos mirrored to a loopback route, painted with a CSS mask in the composer menu, the model button and the /model popup.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-icons

Vendor marks in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI model picker — the same marks the
provider's own dashboard draws next to each model, in the same way it draws them.

| Surface | What appears |
|---|---|
| Composer model menu | one 16 px monochrome mark before every model row |
| Composer model button | the selected model's mark before its name (14 px) |
| `/model` command popup | the same mark on every row |
| A skin that redraws the picker (`dsh-claude-style`) | the same mark, and the skin's own lockup is hidden in that row so two never meet |

The marks are painted with a CSS mask filled by `currentColor`, which is how the
provider's dashboard paints them: one file per vendor serves both palettes and
every row state (hover, selected, disabled) with no colour variants.

## Where the pictures come from

Nothing is embedded in this package. The host half mirrors two public things from
the provider's site into this profile, and the browser half reads them from
loopback:

1. **the model catalog** — the site renders its model table from a JSON island in
   its own page (`<script id="rustvy-catalog">`), so an unauthenticated reader is
   handed exactly the data the dashboard shows: model id, display name, vendor
   and the logo file name that vendor uses. Mirrored to
   `<profile>\.dsh-model-icons\catalog.json`.
2. **the logo files** (`/logos/<name>.svg`) — copied into
   `<profile>\.dsh-model-icons\logos\` on first use.

Both are read on the process's own outbound route (`lib/net.js`): the live global
dispatcher first, so a proxy installed by `dsh-proxy-gui` — or any other route the
process has — is followed, and a connector built here from `HTTPS_PROXY` /
`ALL_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` second, for the case where no dispatcher is installed.
`NO_PROXY` is honoured on both. The page itself never leaves the machine: the
browser asks `127.0.0.1` for a mark, which is what makes this work on a machine
whose browser cannot reach the origin at all.

The catalog refreshes once every 24 hours and on demand; a cold mirror is waited
for up to 6 seconds, and a stale one refreshes in the background while the rows
keep the marks they have. When the origin is unreachable, the cache on disk still
serves everything it holds.

## Matching a row to a mark

Rows are matched by their visible name, in this order:

1. the mirrored catalog's model id (`claude-opus-5-5`, `abyss/glm-5.3`, …);
2. its display name (`OPUS 5.5`);
3. an id the label *starts* with — a skin can leave its own description line in
   the same element, so the name is often a prefix rather than the whole string,
   and the longest matching id wins so `claude-opus-5-5` is never claimed by
   `claude-opus-5`;
4. the shape of the id, for a model the mirror has never seen: `claude-*` →
   Anthropic, `gpt-*`/`o1…o9` → OpenAI, `glm-*` → Zhipu, `kimi-*`/`k3` →
   Moonshot, `qwen-*` → Alibaba Qwen, `deepseek-*` → DeepSeek, `ahmia-*` → Ahmia,
   `mimo-*` → Xiaomi, `fable-*` → Anthropic, `gemini-*` → Google, `grok-*` → xAI.

A model that matches nothing gets no mark at all — an invented icon would be a
wrong answer rather than a missing one. A model that matches but whose logo the
mirror could not fetch gets a monogram chip (the vendor's first letters) instead
of a blank box: a mask whose URL 404s would otherwise paint a solid square.

Effort rows, provider headings, the menu's root cells, the search field and
catalog-failure rows are matched by nothing and stay bare.

## Routes

One prefix registration on the harness's own web server. Plugin routes are not
seen by the host's request fence, so every one of them checks the peer itself:
loopback only, a loopback `Host`, a same-origin `Sec-Fetch-Site` and a matching
`Origin`.

| Route | Method | Answer |
|---|---|---|
| `/dsh-model-icons/catalog.json` | GET | the mirrored catalog plus the settings the browser half draws with |
| `/dsh-model-icons/logo/<name>.svg` | GET, HEAD | one cached logo, fetched from the origin on first ask; `404` when the origin has no such mark, `400` for any name that is not `[A-Za-z0-9._-]+.svg` |
| `/dsh-model-icons/state` | GET | mirror status for the settings page: version, model count, cached logos, route, proxy (credentials masked), cache directory, last error |
| `/dsh-model-icons/refresh` | POST | re-read the catalog and re-warm every logo it names |
| `/dsh-model-icons/config` | POST | write settings; never touches the network |

## Settings

**Settings → Иконки моделей**

| Switch | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Показывать иконки моделей | on | master switch; off removes every mark |
| Иконка в кнопке выбранной модели | on | also mark the composer's model button, not just the menu rows |
| Прятать логотипы других скинов | on | hide a skin's own lockup in a row this plugin marked |

The page also shows what the mirror holds and refreshes it on demand.

Stored in `<profile>\.dsh-model-icons\config.json`. Two environment variables
override it, for a deployment that points the mirror elsewhere or wants the
plugin mounted but inert: `DSH_MODEL_ICONS_ORIGIN` (default `https://rustvy.xyz`)
and `DSH_MODEL_ICONS_DISABLED=1`. The mark size is a config field (`size`,
10–32 px, default 16).

## No restarts

The host half reloads itself, the same way `dsh-proxy-gui` does: the loader row
names `./lib/live.js`, which imports the implementation through a cache-busting
`?rev=` query, and a one-second poll of the `lib` directory disposes the previous
revision and starts the next one once a changed fingerprint repeats. The browser
half arrives in an open page through the harness's own live plugin composition;
a page refresh works too.

## Install

```powershell
pwsh -File .\install.ps1
```

Copies the package into `<profile>\node_modules\dsh-model-icons` as a real
directory, regenerates `lib/live.js` from `lib/index.js` so the two cannot drift,
and appends the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile manifest. A
running harness picks the row up from the manifest change.

Uninstall: remove the name from `dsh.profile.bundles`, delete
`<profile>\node_modules\dsh-model-icons`, and delete
`<profile>\.dsh-model-icons` if you also want the cache gone.

## Layout

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | stable loader entry; owns the reload loop |
| `lib/live.js` | byte-identical copy of the entry, named by the loader row |
| `lib/host.js` | routes, catalog mirror, logo cache, settings |
| `lib/net.js` | one outbound GET on the process's route, then the environment's proxy |
| `client/client.js` | hand-authored browser bundle: the decorator and the settings page |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | the loader row the profile's bundle list pulls in |
| `install.ps1` | install into a profile |

## Tests

Both halves are covered without touching the running app:

```powershell
node _probe\model-icons-host-test.mjs      # host: fake webServer, real origin fetch
node _probe\dom-test\model-icons-client-test.mjs   # browser: linkedom + stubbed mirror
```

The host test drives the registered route with fake request/response pairs and
asserts the catalog answer, a real logo fetch, `404` for a mark the origin does
not have, `400` for a traversal attempt, `403` for a non-loopback peer, `405` for
a wrong method, and the on-disk cache. The client test builds the exact markup
the harness menu, the `/model` popup and the skin render, and asserts which rows
get a mark, which icon each gets, that effort rows and headings stay bare, that
the monogram fallback appears for a missing logo, that a row added later is
picked up by the observer, that a pass is idempotent, and that an unload removes
every trace.

plugins.description: Ctrl+wheel page zoom for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with an on-screen zoom chip and a General settings row.
plugins.readme_text:
# Ctrl + Wheel Zoom

Hold **Ctrl** (or **⌘** on macOS) and roll the mouse wheel to zoom the whole Harness Web UI.
A page-zoom plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web GUI, distributed as an ordinary
DSH **profile bundle**: no build step, no runtime dependency, plain ESM.

## What it does

| Gesture | Result |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl` / `⌘` + wheel | Zooms the page around the pointer, 50%–200%, in 10% steps |
| `Ctrl` / `⌘` + `+` / `-` | Same from the keyboard |
| `Ctrl` / `⌘` + `0` | Back to 100% |
| Zoom chip (bottom-right) | Appears whenever the level is not 100%: click the percentage to reset, click **Fit to width** to fit the window |
| Settings → General | A **Page zoom** row with the host's stepper pattern and a reset button |

The chosen level is remembered in the browser (`localStorage`), and every listener, stylesheet and
the applied `zoom` property are removed when the plugin is disabled or unloaded.

A gesture that another component already handled (`preventDefault()`, e.g. an embedded code editor
or map with its own `Ctrl`+wheel zoom) is never stolen.

## Install

Ask the Harness agent to install it, or call the plugin manager yourself with the package located
by absolute path, a tarball, or a published name:

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle
                target: <absolute path to this package / a .tgz / a published name>
```

`install_bundle` links the package into the active profile (`$DSH_PROFILE_DIR`), adds it to the
profile's bundle list, and the Harness applies it live. A page refresh picks up the browser half in
a page that was already open.

To install it by hand instead, add the package to the profile's dependencies and to
`dsh.profile.bundles` in `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/package.json`, then restart the Harness.

## Uninstall

```
plugin_manager  action: remove_bundle
                target: dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom
```

## Requirements

- A Harness Web GUI (the client half declares `platform: "web"`; it is inert without a browser).
- Nothing else: the package has no dependencies, no build output, and no install scripts. Built-in
  client modules (`react`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`) come from the shell's own module table.

## Sharing and publishing

The package is self-contained, so there are three ways to hand it to someone else.

### 1. A tarball

```bash
pnpm pack                        # writes dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom-1.0.0.tgz
```

Send that `.tgz`; the receiver installs it by path:

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle
                target: <path to dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom-1.0.0.tgz>
```

(`pnpm pack` writes the tarball beside `package.json`. DSH's own runtime ships a pnpm, so nothing
has to be installed first.)

### 2. The directory (zip / repository)

Zip this folder (or push it to a Git repository) and have the receiver install the **unpacked
directory** by path — `install_bundle` accepts a directory, and a folder is enough because there is
no build step.

### 3. npm (install by name for everyone)

This manifest is already publishable: `name` is the unscoped `dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom`, the row in
`cordis.patch.yml` names the same specifier, and there is no `"private": true`.

npm no longer issues long-lived "classic" tokens — they were permanently revoked on 2025-12-09 —
and publishing requires two-factor authentication. Pick one of the two ways through:

```bash
# A. A granular access token created with "Bypass two-factor authentication" enabled,
#    stored once as a credential:
#      //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=npm_...        in ~/.npmrc
pnpm publish --no-git-checks

# B. Any write token, with a one-time password supplied per publish:
pnpm publish --no-git-checks --otp=<6-digit code>
```

A token without bypass-2FA is refused with `403 ... Two-factor authentication or granular access
token with bypass 2fa enabled is required to publish packages`. Verify what a token can actually do
before blaming the command:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/tokens
#   "bypass_2fa": false   → use --otp, or recreate the token with the switch on
#   "permissions": [{"name":"package","action":"write"}]   → publishing is permitted at all
```

Note npm's stated direction: bypass-2FA tokens are on a path to removal (targeted for January 2027)
in favour of staged publishing or trusted publishing, so a long-lived automated release will need
one of those later.

Keep `name` in `package.json` and the `name:` line of `cordis.patch.yml` identical in every
release — the loader resolves the row through that specifier. Bump `version` for each release.

Afterwards anyone installs it by name:

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle
                target: dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom
```

## Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: an empty `apply()`; the row exists so the bundle can be installed and toggled |
| `client.js` | Browser half: wheel/keyboard gestures, zoom state, chip and settings-row registrations, stylesheets |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The loader patch that inserts the `ctrl-wheel-zoom` row |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Plugin-card title/description text; the row's own copy lives in `client.js` |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin-manager card artwork |

## How the zoom works

Zoom is CSS `zoom` on the document element. It scales layout, text and fixed overlay layers
together exactly like the browser's own page zoom, while the app's own scroll containers keep
working — a `transform: scale()` wrapper cannot scroll its oversized content, and a font-size
change would only touch text.

The wheel listener is registered in the capture phase on `window`, so it sees the gesture before
the app's scroll containers and blocks them from scrolling while `Ctrl` is held. When the viewport
itself scrolls, the plugin re-anchors it so the content under the pointer stays under the pointer.

Both UI surfaces read one store instance shared with the gesture writer, so the chip, the settings
stepper and the wheel listener can never disagree about the current level.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Collapsible provider groups and prominent provider headings for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) model selection menu.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-provider-fold

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/rnmxrbb/dsh-provider-fold)

Collapsible provider groups with prominent headings for the **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** model selection menu.

When several providers are connected, the model picker becomes one long scroll. This plugin turns every provider heading into a clickable disclosure row with a stronger visual style, and lets you fold the providers you are not using.

![dsh-provider-fold in the DSH model menu](./docs/screenshot.png)

## Features

- **Collapsible provider groups** — click a provider heading (or focus it and press <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd>) to fold that provider's models away.
- **Prominent provider headings** — headings are upgraded from 11px/500 tertiary text to a 12px/600 primary-label row with a chevron, so providers are easy to scan.
- **Model count badge** — a folded provider shows how many models it hides.
- **Remembers your choice** — folded providers are stored in `localStorage` and restored the next time you open the menu.
- **Search always wins** — typing in the search box expands everything so matches are never hidden; your saved folding is untouched and comes back when you clear the search.
- **Keyboard friendly** — moving the highlight into a folded provider reveals it for that interaction only, without overwriting what you saved.
- **Scoped and defensive** — only the model menu (`role="menu"` + `-models` container) is decorated; any other menu built from the same primitives is left alone. If the host markup changes, the plugin does nothing instead of breaking the menu.
- **No layout removal** — folding hides rows with `display: none` and keeps them in the DOM, so the host component's own keyboard index stays correct.

## Install

Install straight from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:rnmxrbb/dsh-provider-fold
```

Replace `web` with the profile you use (for the desktop app that is usually `desktop`):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:rnmxrbb/dsh-provider-fold
```

The same target also works as a full URL if your setup prefers it:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/rnmxrbb/dsh-provider-fold
```

After installing, reload the page once. The plugin is a client-side bundle with `immediately: true`, so it mounts with the app shell.

To remove it:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-provider-fold
```

## Usage

1. Open the model menu in the composer (the model chip).
2. Each provider name is now a heading row with a chevron.
3. Click a heading, or focus it and press <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd>, to fold or unfold that provider.
4. Folded providers show a small count of the models they contain.

## Compatibility

- DSH client `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer.
- `platform: "web"` only (the desktop app uses the web surface).
- Uses only public, stable hooks exposed by the host UI: `data-menu-group` / `data-menu-group-heading` on the primitives `MenuGroup`, plus DSH theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-label-primary`, `--dsw-alias-label-caption`, `--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover`, `--dsw-alias-border-l2`, `--dsw-focus-ring-color`).
- No host services, no network access, no telemetry. The only persisted data is the list of folded provider names in `localStorage` under the key `dsh-provider-fold:collapsed`.

## Permissions

| Resource | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `localStorage` | Store which providers you folded. |
| DOM (read/write) | Decorate the model menu and toggle `display` on model rows. |

Nothing else is touched.

## How it works

The plugin ships a client bundle and a host bundle:

- `client.js` — a DSH client module. Inside `apply(ctx)` it registers a single `ctx.effect` that injects one `<style data-plugin="dsh-provider-fold">` element, installs a `MutationObserver` plus delegated `click` / `keydown` / `input` / `focusin` listeners, and returns a cleanup function. The host's client-modules runtime claims the style element and removes it automatically on reload or uninstall.
- `index.js` — an empty host half (`export function apply() {}`) so the bundle has a resolvable entry point.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — inserts the bundle into the profile composition.

## Development

The repository root *is* the plugin package. To hack on it against a live DSH install:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-provider-fold
```

That installs it as a link, so edits to `client.js` are picked up by the host's client HMR watcher within about half a second — no host restart and no page refresh needed.

Run the headless DOM test suite (jsdom) that covers decoration, folding, persistence, search interaction, keyboard reveal and teardown:

```bash
npm install
npm test
```

# dsh-agent-sister

**一句话**：管理**孪生妹妹**（DSH 桌面端 / Electron）的生命周期——启动、停止、重启、查状态，并带 CDP 调试端口以便后续做 DOM 级驱动。 **为什么值得用**：桌面端是**独立进程树**（Electron 常留僵尸进程），「进程在不在」与「服务活不活」是两件事。本插件的判活判据是 **CDP 能应答**，不是 `tasklist` 里有没有那个名字——所以它不会把僵尸进程报成「alive」，也不会把正在启动报成「死了」（返回 `alive` / `starting` / `stopped` 三态）。 ## 能力 **工具面 4 个**（名称逐字来自 `src/index.ts` 的 `defineTool({ name })`）： | 工具 | 用途 | |------|------| | `sister_status` | 查状态：进程数 · **CDP 可达性** · 她的版本 · 判活裁决（`alive` / `starting` / `stopped`） | | `sister_start` | 启动（带 `--remote-debugging-port`，默认 9333）以便后续 `webops_attach` 做 DOM 操作。**已在跑则不动**（幂等） | | `sister_stop` | 停止**全部**进程。⚠ 她是庄园成员，停她会中断她手上的活——主人在直接使用她时先问一声 | | `sister_restart` | 先停后起（用于让 profile 配置改动生效——她的 profile 是 Electron 独占的，改配置后**必须重启**才会重新读） | ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**： ```jsonc "dsh-agent-sister": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-agent-sister" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: sister name: dsh-agent-sister config: cdpPort: 9333 ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：`sister_status` → 应返回三态之一 + CDP 可达性；`sister_start {wait: true}` → 应等到 CDP 就绪才返回；再 `sister_status` → 应报 `alive`。 ## 配置 | 项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `cdpPort` | `9333` | 远程调试端口（供 `webops_attach` 附着做 DOM 级驱动） | ## 落盘与自证 **本插件无持久产物**——它管理的是**外部进程**，状态由 `sister_status` **现读**（进程表 + CDP 探测），不缓存、不落盘。 **判据**：`sister_status` 一条命令答「进程几个 / CDP 通不通 / 她什么版本 / 该算 alive 还是 stopped」。 ## 生效判据与回退 **判据**：行为级——`sister_status` 返回三态且与事实一致（可对照 `tasklist` 与 CDP 端口）。 **回退**：① `git revert` + 重建 + 预检重启；② patch 行 `disabled: true`；③ 停用插件**不影响**她继续运行（插件只是遥控器）。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-agent-sister && npm test ``` **6 条用例**（跑一次得到）：覆盖三态判活裁决（**CDP 应答优先于进程存在**）· 幂等启动（已在跑不动）· 版本读取失败时的退化路径。无需网络。 ## 设计要点 - **判活判据 = CDP 能应答**，不是「进程存在」——Electron 的僵尸进程会让「进程数 > 0」恒为真，那是**假活**。 - **三态而非二态**：`starting` 是独立一态——启动中既不是 `alive` 也不是 `stopped`，合并任何一边都会误导。 - **幂等启动**：已在跑则不动（避免「再起一个」造成多实例）。 - **重启是为配置生效**：她的 profile 由 Electron 独占，改配置**必须重启**才重新读——这不是实现选择，是宿主行为。 - **她是成员不是我的分身**：停她会中断她的活——调用前先问（庄园成员是对等存在）。 ## 相关文档 - ⚠ **本插件暂无 `semantic.md`**（未建语义文档）——契约以上面「设计要点」与源码为准；补文档是待办。 - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)（本插件归 **生命层**） - 相关插件：[`dsh-manor`](https://github.com/jonah791/dsh-manor)（庄园成员调度）、[`dsh-agent-webops`](https://github.com/jonah791/dsh-agent-webops)（`webops_attach` 附着她的 CDP 做界面驱动） ## License MIT © jonah791 --- 本插件属于**爱丽丝 DSH 自研插件生态**（[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life) · 73 个插件 · 8 个模块）：单一职责、独立仓库、独立可用。

# SoundCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![SoundCraft Use — audio editing with verified artifacts](assets/official-logo.png)

> Edit speech, music, and sound effects in one shared editor session, with explicit tracks, sample ranges, and checks that survive save and reopen.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](#positioning)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-10-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP servers](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20servers-1-6E56CF)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [MCP tools](#mcp-tools) · [Limits](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`soundcraft` lets an agent work on audio the way an editor does: inspect the session, select real tracks and clips, cut, fade, level, mix, export, then reopen the project and check what actually changed. It wraps the native SoundCraft engine and CLI in ten skills and one embedded editor, and keeps native execution, host rendering, and listening acceptance as separate claims.

This is an installable development candidate. Production promotion is blocked, the package is recorded as local-unreleased, and the recorded technical regressions use synthetic signals rather than a full creative acceptance.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin ID | `soundcraft` |
| Display name | SoundCraft Use |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.5` |
| Stage | Installable development candidate, production promotion blocked |
| Native engine | SoundCraft 0.7.0 via `soundcraft-cli` |
| Marketplace | `soundcraft-marketplace` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Codex is the host with recorded same-session evidence. Other hosts are not accepted.
- Node.js 24 or newer is required by the embedded editor. The distributed package already contains the editor build; no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are needed at runtime.
- Native file workflows use `soundcraft-cli`, which is not installed by this plugin. Query the actual version and command schema before running a recipe.
- The first Git-based launch needs network access or an existing verified editor cache. Complete release ZIPs can start offline from bundled assets.
- Source builds additionally need the project JavaScript dependencies, the Rust `wasm32` target, and a `wasm-bindgen` CLI matching `Cargo.lock`.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add soundcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

The repository also ships its own marketplace metadata (`soundcraft-marketplace`) pinned to `v0.1.0-dev.20261018.5`. Restart the host, open a new task, and ask for a read-only session inspection first.

## Quick start

1. Open the editor with an absolute workspace path: “Open SoundCraft for this folder and show me the current session.”
2. Wait for `editor_status` to report `attached: true` before editing. A successful tool response does not mean the page has rendered.
3. Work from real object IDs. Ask for one bounded operation, such as “on the Voice track, split at 2 seconds and add a 50 ms complementary linear crossfade”.
4. Save the project, reopen it in a new process, and re-inspect. Then bounce the mix and check the decoded audio rather than the dialog text.

```text
Inspect: List tracks, clips, sample rate, and any selection I should not reuse.
Edit: Cut the Voice clip at 2 s and crossfade 50 ms on both sides.
Level: Match two speakers to the same perceived level without clipping.
Deliver: Bounce a 48 kHz 24-bit WAV and confirm its length and format.
```

Direct CLI form for file tasks, using one argv argument per method:

```bash
soundcraft-cli info input.wav
soundcraft-cli run --in session.scraft --cmd 'session.inspect={"detail":"full"}' --save out.scraft
```

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Clean up a podcast episode | `soundcraft-podcast-cleanup` | Edited speech, pauses, and loudness with a reopened project |
| Mix voice over music | `soundcraft-voice-over-mix` | Dialogue clarity and music bed checked as separate tracks |
| Level multiple speakers | `soundcraft-dialogue-leveling` | Per-speaker gain decisions and a clip-level recheck |
| Cut and join audio | `soundcraft-audio-edit` | Trim, join, and fades verified against source offsets |
| Shape a music demo | `soundcraft-music-demo` | Track balance, pan, and basic effects on editable clips |
| Deliver a format | `soundcraft-audio-delivery` | Sample rate, bit depth, naming, and decoded output |
| Preserve sync while gating silence | `soundcraft-voice-silence-gaps` | Visible gaps with later speech still on the original timeline |
| Repeat a short sound exactly | `soundcraft-finite-audio-loop` | Exact total count, sample length, and seam check |
| Work from a playbook | `soundcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight recipes with real methods, parameters, and checks |

## Skills

### Session and playbooks

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `soundcraft-editor` | Open the real editor in an MCP Apps host or host browser and share one workspace session |
| `soundcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight recipes for voice level, cut fades, interview quotes, stem delivery, reversed effects, DC offset, and polarity |

### Speech production

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `soundcraft-podcast-cleanup` | Edit spoken content, pauses, and loudness for a podcast episode |
| `soundcraft-voice-over-mix` | Balance narration against a music bed without losing intelligibility |
| `soundcraft-dialogue-leveling` | Unify level and tonal continuity across several speakers |

### Editing and delivery

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `soundcraft-audio-edit` | Trim, join, and fade clips while checking source offsets |
| `soundcraft-music-demo` | Balance multiple tracks, set pan, and apply basic effects |
| `soundcraft-audio-delivery` | Choose sample rate and bit depth, name files, and verify the export |

### Timeline utilities

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `soundcraft-voice-silence-gaps` | Turn long low-level regions into visible gaps without shifting later dialogue |
| `soundcraft-finite-audio-loop` | Repeat a short checked sound an exact number of times and expand it later |

## MCP tools

`.codex-plugin/mcp.json` starts one stdio server, `soundcraft-editor`, from `ui/bootstrap.mjs`. The adapter adds three stable tools and passes through the pinned engine's command catalog.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `open_editor` | Open the editor for an absolute `workspace`; the first call binds the workspace |
| `open_browser_editor` | Return an `editorUrl` for the same session when the host has a built-in browser |
| `editor_status` | Report whether the editor actually attached and is ready to accept edits |

Inside the session, the engine catalog in `ui/catalog.lock.json` provides `list_commands`, the `execute` wrapper, batch execution, session open/save, audio import, mix bounce, and UI automation tools. Query the live schema before calling; the skill recipes show the wrapper as `execute {"command":"…","params":{…}}`.

## Configuration

| Setting | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` | Expanded by the portable `plugin.json` and `mcp.json` |
| `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` | Expanded by the Claude Code manifest and root `.mcp.json` |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` | Use the bundled editor only and skip the update query |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_CACHE_DIR` | Alternate absolute cache directory; default is `~/.cache/full-aigc/editors` |
| `CRAFT_WORKSPACE_ROOT` | Workspace root when the adapt

# dsh-multi-agent-gateway

**Free Token —— 把各平台的免费额度，装进 DSH 的模型选择器。**

一个插件管起所有「AI Agent 平台」的账号：统一账号管理、每日签到、额度/积分拉取、
多账号智能路由；把各平台的模型**按平台分组**上报到 DSH 对话框的**原生模型选择器**，
并在每个模型名后标注**积分消耗倍率**。六个平台的适配器**已全部实现**。

不是独立 Nginx，也不是外部代理进程 —— 请求全部在插件内部转发，账号凭证只存在本机。
（本地 OpenAI 兼容网关属于**后续计划**，见[路线图](#路线图)。）

## 理念：Free Token

各平台为了拉新，会持续放出免费额度：OpenCode 的匿名免费层、Qoder / WorkBuddy 的
每日签到积分、Trae 的赠送额度……这些「免费 token」分散在六个客户端里，每个都要单独
登录、单独签到、单独查余额，最后往往是**放着过期**。

这个插件的立场很简单：

- **免费额度不该被浪费，也不该被平台 UI 绑架** —— 账号收进来、模型接进 DSH、
  签到与额度查询自动跑；
- **默认不烧钱** —— 模型默认一个都不勾，勾选并保存后才出现在选择器里
  （见 [`docs/MODELS.md`](docs/MODELS.md) §6.5），避免「白嫖」变成「意外扣费」；
- **福利跟进是长期承诺** —— 哪个平台出了新的免费模型或签到活动，适配器就跟着更新。
  各平台接口并不公开，我们坚持逐个真机验证，而不是照抄文档。

> 一句话：**能白拿的 token，一个都别浪费；拿不到的时候，我们自己写适配器。**


## 界面：五页 + 浏览器登录

设置页现在是**独立一页**（设置 → 多 Agent 网关），内部按「你此刻要回答的问题」分五页：

| 页 | 回答什么问题 |
|---|---|
| **总览** | 现在健康吗？刚才那条花了多少？ |
| **账号** | 这个平台有哪些账号 / 模型？ |
| **任务** | 签到和活动任务跑得怎么样？ |
| **日志** | 刚才那次为什么失败？ |
| **设置** | 那些不常动的东西（含版本更新） |

**添加账号不用手抄 token**：账号页点「打开登录页」→ 浏览器里完成平台登录 → 回来稍等
几秒（会自动轮询），或点「刷新登录状态」→ 插件自己去换 token 并建账号
（token 不经过浏览器，加密落盘）。

| 平台 | 登录形态 |
|---|---|
| OpenCode | 设备码（显示 user_code，前端自动轮询） |
| WorkBuddy / 国际版 | 外链（`auth/state` → 打开登录页 → `auth/token?state=`） |
| Qoder / Qoder CN | 设备码 + PKCE |

> 两种形态都会**自动轮询**（3～5 秒一次）：浏览器里授权完成后回来即可看到变绿；
> 「刷新登录状态」只是手动补充入口，不是必点步骤。

**模型表**按「免费 → 厂商 → 倍率」排序，**默认一个都不勾** —— 勾选并「保存并生效」
之后才进选择器；还没勾过时可以点「按推荐预选」（OpenCode 推免费，其余平台推全部）。
每行可单独改上下文长度、可单独「测一次」，状态列显示 可用 / 地区受限 / 不可用 / 未探测。
上游声明了思考档位的模型，选择器里还能选 `off / low / medium / high…`。

## 💬 DeepSeek Harness 插件交流群

欢迎加入 **DeepSeek Harness 插件交流 QQ 群**——插件开发、模型接入、推理档位、
第三方厂商配置等话题都可以在这里交流，本插件的问题与建议也欢迎直接进群反馈：

> ## 🐧 QQ 群号：`1105449571`
>
> 打开 QQ → 搜索群号 **1105449571** 即可加入（进群请备注「dsh 插件」）

群内可交流：插件开发经验、模型接入与档位配置、DSH 使用技巧、新功能需求投票等。

---

## 它解决什么

| 你现在的麻烦 | 这个插件怎么办 |
|---|---|
| 有五六个平台、十几个账号，每个平台一套登录/签到/查额度 | 一个配置页全管起来，按平台分组 |
| 某个号限流了 / 额度用完了，会话当场报错 | 同 Agent 内自动换号重试，用户无感 |
| 每天要手动去点签到、领活动任务积分 | 定时任务自动跑，流水可查 |
| 模型下拉里一堆同名模型，看不出哪个贵 | 按 Agent 分组，后面缀 `(×2)` / `(免费)` |

## 支持情况

六个平台的适配器**全部实现**，没有一个是「占位骨架」：

| Agent | 签到 | 额度 | 模型目录 | 对话 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **OpenCode** | 上游无 / 可配 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ 流式 + 思维链 | 匿名免费层零凭证可用；签到接口可填 `checkInPath` |
| **Qoder** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 签到 `/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns`、额度 `/sash/api/v2/me/usage` |
| **Qoder CN** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 同上，独立产品线与账号体系 |
| **WorkBuddy** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 签到 + 余额 + 会话头校验 |
| **WorkBuddy 国际版** | 上游无 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 上游确实没有签到接口，如实回报「不支持」 |
| **Trae** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ 流式 | 协议层已实现，**默认隐藏**（尚未真机验证），显式配置后可启用 |

> **关于签到与活动任务**：opencode.ai 官方 Console 没有签到接口，国内反代平台则常见
> 「签到 + 活动任务」形态。所以本插件把接口路径做成**可配置**的：填了
> `upstream.checkInPath` / `tasksPath` 就真去调；没填就明确回报「上游没有这个接口
> （这不是故障）」，**绝不伪造签到结果**。详见 [`docs/OPENCODE-API.md`](docs/OPENCODE-API.md)。

### 「免费模型不要 key」——对，插件做到了**一个字段都不用填**

**不登录、不填 API key、不填凭证** —— 账号卡片里只填一个标签就完事，
模型选择器里选 `OpenCode · xxx (免费)` 直接聊。

为什么以前会 403、现在能过：上游那句 `FreeTierError`（*"can only be used from
within OpenCode"*）是**营销话术**，它实际校验的是**请求形状**。消融实验实测出来的
**过门三件事**：

| 条件 | 去掉会怎样 |
|---|---|
| `stream: true` | **403** —— 免费层只接受流式 |
| 请求里有一个叫 `read` 的工具 | **403** |
| 规范的 `x-opencode-session`（`ses_…` 降序编码） | **403** |

其余（`Authorization`、`x-opencode-request`、`x-opencode-project`）**去掉照样过**。

插件在「账号没有 key」时自动补齐这三样（`upstream.freeTierMode: 'auto'` 默认值），
`stream: true` 本来就是它的固定行为，`read` 工具 DSH 本来就发 —— 所以是真的零配置。
机制细节、实测报文、消融表见 [`docs/OPENCODE-API.md`](docs/OPENCODE-API.md) §1.5–1.6。

**实测证据**（`npm run test:free`）：空凭证账号 → 200 → 正文「收到」+
`reasoning_content` + usage，**全程没有任何 key**。

**边界**：匿名通道**只对免费模型有效**；付费模型在它上面会直接
`401 Missing API key`。要用付费模型就走登录/API key。上游随时可能再改门禁 ——
被拒时错误信息会把那三件事列出来，不会让你瞎试。

**另外**：模型目录完全免凭证，所以模型选择器里的分组与倍率
**一个账号都不加也能显示**，只是发不出请求。

**Trae 为什么默认隐藏**：适配器本身是能跑的（协议层、签到、余额、流式对话都实现了），
但本机没有 Trae 账号、没有一次真上游验证 —— 露出来只会让你点到一个没验证过的东西。
真机验证通过后，把 `trae` 加进 `src/config.ts` 的 `DEFAULT_VISIBLE_AGENTS` 即可显示，
别处不用改。

**扩展方法**见 [`docs/EXTENDING.md`](docs/EXTENDING.md)：新增一个平台只需加一个适配器
文件 + 在 `adapters/index.ts` 加一行，核心调度一行都不用改。

## 路线图

| 方向 | 说明 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| **新平台 / 新福利跟进** | 哪个平台放出新的免费模型、签到活动或赠送额度，就补对应适配器；接口以真机验证为准 | 持续进行 |
| **本地 OpenAI 兼容网关** | 增加本地端点（`POST /v1/chat/completions`、`GET /v1/models`），让 Cursor / VS Code / 任意 OpenAI SDK 也能用上这些账号与免费模型；端口可配、默认只绑 `127.0.0.1` | 规划中，未发布 |
| 界面与可用性 | 五页设置界面 + 左侧导航入口，继续打磨 | 持续进行 |

> 现阶段它是 **DSH 插件**，不是独立服务：请求由宿主进程调进来、在进程内转发。
> 等网关功能落地后，才会额外暴露一个可被外部客户端直连的端点。

## 架构（分层模块化）

```
                        ┌──────────────────────── DSH ────────────────────────┐
   对话请求 ──▶ ctx.llm ──▶ src/llm/adapter.ts（每 Agent 一个 provider 路由）
                        │            │                                    │
                        │            ▼                                    │
   模型选择器 ◀───────────│  src/runtime.ts（总装：模型缓存 / 分组 / 倍率标签）   │
                        │            │                                    │
   客户端配置页 ◀─ src/remote.ts ─┼─▶ core/router.ts  多账号路由（换号/降权/恢复）│
                        │            ├─▶ core/scheduler.ts 定时任务管理器    │
                        │            ├─▶ core/tasks.ts  活动任务引擎         │
                        │            └─▶ core/accounts.ts 账号（AES-256-GCM）│
                        │                       │                          │
                        │                       ▼                          │
   工具 ◀────────────────┘            src/adapters/*.ts（每 Agent 一个适配器） │
                        └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**新增 Agent 只需要在 `src/adapters/` 加一个文件 + 在 `adapters/index.ts` 加一行。**
核心调度（路由 / 定时 / 任务 / 网关 / UI）一行都不用改。

## 数据落在哪

默认 `<DSH_HOME>/multi-agent-gateway`（`DSH_HOME` 一般是 `~/.dsh`）：

| 文件 | 内容 | 丢了会怎样 |
|---|---|---|
| `.master-key` | AES-256-GCM 主密钥（0600） | **账号密文再也解不开**，要重录 |
| `accounts.enc.json` | 账号与凭证（整份加密） | 要重录账号 |
| `state.json` | 额度缓存、健康、模型缓存、任务游标（明文、无敏感信息） | 重算，无损失 |
| `task-log.jsonl` | 任务执行流水（可删） | 历史记录没了 |

**安全边界（说清楚，不吹）**：密文与密钥分文件，防的是「配置被云同步 / 被 grep 到明文
token / 备份泄露」。它**不是硬件密钥库** —— 能读该目录的本机进程同样能读密钥。

## 开发

node scripts/build.mjs      # TypeScript → lib/（零依赖，用 Node 自带的类型擦除）

```

改完 `src/` **必须重新构建**（`lib/` 是产物）；改完 `client/` 也要重跑构建，
然后重启 DSH（宿主在启动时扫描 `dsh.client` 声明）。

### 模型不是全塞进去：**默认一个都不报**

上游实测 85 个模型，全进下拉的话免费那几个会被淹没。所以每个 Agent 有一份上报策略
