plugins.readme_text: # dsh-memory-system-prompt **中文** | [English](#english) 全局记忆插件：AI 可以主动把事实写进记忆文件，并在后续对话里按需读取。记忆索引每轮自动注入系统提示，**不占用对话上下文**。 同时包含**用户级系统提示词**功能（原先独立的 `dsh-system-prompt` 已并入本包），两部分共用同一个设置页。 ## 它解决什么 模型本身没有跨会话记忆。这个插件给出一份可持久、可检索的记忆区： - **AI 主动写**：对话中发现的稳定事实（偏好、约定、环境细节）由模型调用工具写入； - **索引常驻**：每轮把「标题 + 一句话摘要」注入系统提示，模型知道有什么； - **正文按需**：需要细节时再调工具读全文，不把整个记忆库塞进上下文； - **可按对话关**：某个对话不想带记忆时，单独关掉。 ## 工具 | 工具 | 作用 | |---|---| | `memory_save` | 保存或更新一条记忆（同名覆盖） | | `memory_read` | 按标识读取一条记忆的正文 | | `memory_list` | 列出全部记忆（默认只返回索引） | | `memory_delete` | 删除一条记忆 | ## 用户级系统提示词 写一次，对所有对话生效；也可以按对话单独禁用。 - **自定义正文**：任何想长期强加给模型的要求（语气、格式、禁止事项）； - **九维风格档位**：不想写长文时，用档位拼出一段行为指令（基础语气、亲切程度、热情程度、表情符号、可视化回答、标题和列表、快速回答、提示词建议、回答长度）； - **两种注入位置**：作为系统提示的一部分，或作为上下文片段。 档位默认都是「默认」，全部保持默认时不产生任何额外内容。 ## 界面 - **输入框左侧开关**：三态（关 / 部分 / 开），按对话生效； - **设置 → 记忆与提示词**：管理全局开关、单条记忆、系统提示词与风格档位、首次使用引导。 ## 存储 | 路径 | 内容 | |---|---| | `~/.dsh/memory/` | 每条记忆一个文件 | | `~/.dsh/memory-settings.json` | 记忆的全局开关与偏好 | | `~/.dsh/system-prompt/settings.json` | 系统提示词与风格档位 | ## 安装 **推荐：内置插件安装程序。** 打开「设置 → 内置插件」，粘贴包名，点安装，再重启应用： ``` dsh-memory-system-prompt ``` 安装程序会自动写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不用手改任何文件。 命令行方式（先完全退出应用）： ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-memory-system-prompt ``` 然后把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启应用。 ## 注意 - 记忆索引通过 `systemPrompt.context` 注入，不是 `agent.inject`——后者会排队成一条用户消息，导致模型在回答完再自问自答一轮。 - 索引刷新挂在 `agent/created` 和 `turn/start` 上，因为在 assemble 之后才拿得到最新内容。 - 系统提示词部分**不把 `systemPrompt` 写进 `inject`**，而是运行时用 `agent.ctx.get('systemPrompt')` 取。硬注入会让 fiber 在服务未就绪时被挂起，表现是插件静默不加载、设置里一片空白。 --- **English** | [中文](#chinese) Global memory for DeepSeek Harness: the model can write facts into a persistent store and read them back later. The index is injected into the system prompt every turn, **without consuming conversation context**. The package also carries the **user-level system prompt** feature (the former standalone `dsh-system-prompt` is merged in). Both halves share one settings page. ## What it solves Models have no cross-session memory. This plugin provides a persistent, searchable memory area: - **The model writes**: stable facts discovered in conversation (preferences, conventions, environment details) are saved through tools; - **The index is always present**: each turn injects "title + one-line summary" into the system prompt, so the model knows what exists; - **Bodies are on demand**: the full text is read only when needed, so the whole store never floods the context; - **Per-conversation opt-out**: a conversation that should not carry memory can turn it off. ## Tools | Tool | Purpose | |---|---| | `memory_save` | Save or update one memory (same slug overwrites) | | `memory_read` | Read one memory body by slug | | `memory_list` | List memories (index only by default) | | `memory_delete` | Delete one memory | ## User-level system prompt Written once, applied to every conversation; can also be disabled per conversation. - **Custom body**: anything you want to impose on the model long-term (tone, format, prohibitions); - **Nine style dials**: build a behavior instruction from dials instead of prose — base tone, warmth, enthusiasm, emoji, visual answers, headings and lists, quick answers, suggestions, verbosity; - **Two injection positions**: part of the system prompt, or a context fragment. Every dial defaults to "default"; keeping all of them default produces no extra content. ## UI - **Composer toggle (left side)**: three states (off / partial / on), per conversation; - **Settings → Memory & Prompt**: global switch, individual memories, system prompt and style dials, first-run guide. ## Storage | Path | Contents | |---|---| | `~/.dsh/memory/` | One file per memory | | `~/.dsh/memory-settings.json` | Global switch and preferences for memory | | `~/.dsh/system-prompt/settings.json` | System prompt and style dials | ## Install **The built-in plugin installer is the recommended way.** Open Settings → Built-in Plugins, paste the package name, press install, then restart the app: ``` dsh-memory-system-prompt ``` The installer writes the entry into `dsh.profile.bundles` for you; no manual file edits. From the command line (quit the app completely first): ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-memory-system-prompt ``` Add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart the app. ## Notes - The memory index is injected through `systemPrompt.context`, not `agent.inject`. The latter queues a user message, which makes the model answer its own question for another turn. - The index refreshes on `agent/created` and `turn/start`, because the content is only current after assembly. - The system-prompt half deliberately does **not** list `systemPrompt` in `inject`; it resolves the service at runtime via `agent.ctx.get('systemPrompt')`. A hard injection parks the fiber while the service is not ready, which shows up as a silently unloaded plugin and an empty settings page.

plugins.description: See which semantic primitives your answer lights up, live — brain-shaped node graph, EEG-style traces, composition card. 语义脉冲 / HowNet 义原可视化
plugins.readme_text:
# 语义脉冲 · dsh-primitive-pulse

在 DSH 里实时看**当前这段回答**点亮了哪些语义基元。右下角一个圆钮，点开是三个面板，也可以切到全屏背景模式。

![面板](assets/screenshots/sfx_panel.png)

**基元星图**——340 个簇铺成立体脑形，被命中的节点变亮，两端都亮的连线更亮：

![基元星图](assets/screenshots/sfx_brain.png)

**基元流 + 指纹卡**——上面是义原沿 token 的激活曲线（脑电样式多导联），下面是按分区聚合的构成表：

![基元流与指纹卡](assets/screenshots/sfx_stream.png)

| 面板 | 看什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 基元星图 | 340 个簇铺成立体脑形：被命中的节点变亮，两端都亮的连线更亮；静息时是一张暗着的网格 |
| 基元流 | 多条多导联，每条是一个义原沿 token 的激活曲线（带衰减拖尾），合成在一张脑电图纸上 |
| 指纹卡 | 义原按分区聚合后的构成表，按占比降序，和样例基线对比 |

**形状是隐喻，不是脑活动。** 面板里没有 fNIRS、没有皮层柱、没有任何神经测量；点亮的依据全部是文本经 HowNet 义原体系分解后的统计。所以页脚写的是「形状是隐喻，不是脑活动」。

## 它到底做了什么

1. 宿主把每轮 assistant 正文交给插件（`session/event` 的 `assistant/message`，不抓屏、不读你的输入）。
2. 正文用内置的中英词表切成词，每个词查 HowNet 义原（2,168 个义原 / 133,759 个中文词 / 48,042 个英文词）。
3. 逐 token 累出「义原激活流」，按指数衰减滚成曲线；同时聚成 340 个簇，投到预生成的三维坐标上。
4. 浏览器端只负责画：一个轮询 `/dsh-pulse/state`，拿到帧自己渲染。

## 装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:DreamLoomStudio/dsh-primitive-pulse
```

装完**重启 DSH Desktop**（宿主在启动时收集一次注入行，运行期加不进来）。重启后：

- 右下角出现圆钮；点它，或按 `Ctrl+Shift+P` 展开面板；
- 想看服务端是否起来，访问 `http://127.0.0.1:43129/dsh-pulse/ping`，返回 JSON 即正常：

```json
{"ok":true,"plugin":"dsh-primitive-pulse","assets":{"widget":25630,"core":11022,"data":4348808},"seq":0,"hasText":false}
```

## 用

- **圆钮可拖动**，位置会记住。
- 面板头部「背景模式」：把星图铺到整个窗口背景，慢慢自转；再点一次关闭（也会记住）。
- 没有新回答时，面板不会空着——回放结束后会按每个节点的峰值做错相位的呼吸，让你仍能看到这段回答激活了哪些区域。
- 手动粘贴：面板底部「手动粘贴」可以贴任意文本（不用等模型回答）试一段。

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-primitive-pulse
```

然后重启 DSH Desktop。

## 数据从哪来

- **2,168 个义原 / 133,759 个中文词 / 48,042 个英文词**：清华 [OpenHowNet](https://github.com/thunlp/OpenHowNet)（HowNet 语义词典）的义原组合，不取例句、不取词频排名。
- **补录 38 条**：HowNet 里没有的现代术语（微分、梯度、插件、面板、残差…）。
- **340 个簇**：义原共现矩阵 → 谱嵌入 → 递归二分聚类，簇名取质心最近的成员义原。
- **三维位置**：侧视剖面取样 + 半球深度 + 空间近邻网格（1,342 条边）。

词表与坐标全部离线打包在 `assets/sememe-data.js`（4.3 MB），**运行时不联网、不调模型、不上传任何内容**。

## 隐私边界

- 插件只在**服务端内存**里保留**最近一段** assistant 正文（`state.text`），进程退出即消失，不落盘、不写日志。
- 浏览器只向**本机**的 `/dsh-pulse/state` 取数据，路由先过宿主的 `connection.requestRejection` 信任栅栏（拿不到栅栏就 fail-closed）。
- 没有账号，没有统计，没有远程上报。

## 已知限制

- 宿主只推「一整条 assistant 消息」，没有逐字 delta：所以是**回答落地后回放**，不是逐字实时。
- 拿不到 `logprobs`（内核目前不暴露），所以没有「模型犹豫度」这一维。
- 多义词按 HowNet 第一个义项算，偶尔会出笑话（`把` → 把手、`世界` → 天体）。
- 未登录词会显示在底部（`未登录义原 N%`），不影响其余部分。

## 开发

先 clone 仓库（`test/` 与 `script/` 不在发布包的 `files` 里，装进 `node_modules` 的那份没有它们）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/DreamLoomStudio/dsh-primitive-pulse.git
cd dsh-primitive-pulse
node test/smoke.mjs            # 核心链路（分词 → 义原流 → 簇帧 → 指纹）
node test/widget_headless.mjs  # 挂件 DOM/Canvas 用最小桩跑一遍
node test/english.mjs          # 英文词表
```

资产同步（如果你在本仓库之外改了 `core.js` / 词表）：`node script/sync-assets.mjs`。

MIT License · 数据来自 OpenHowNet，遵守其原始许可。

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 高效执行 Skill：将确定性操作合并为单次脚本化执行、反馈压缩为摘要并按需深读、本地核验结果、及时停止无效重试 | Efficient tool execution skill for DeepSeek Harness: batches deterministic operations into one scripted pass, compresses feedback to summaries with on-demand deep reads, verifies results locally, and stops unproductive retry loops
plugins.readme_text:
# deepseek-harness-batch-executor

> **简体中文**：面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) 的高效执行 Skill——让**模型只参与真正需要判断的步骤**，把确定性工作合并为一次脚本化执行（程序化工具调用 PTC 纪律），在汇报前**本地核验**结果（数量、sha256 树哈希、差异），并对无效重试**及时止损**。
>
> - 与 Harness 无关：**Python 3.8+ 纯标准库**，零依赖、不联网。
> - 作为 DSH 原生 Skill 安装（`SKILL.md` + 辅助脚本），也可在任何能运行 Python 的 Agent 环境中直接使用。
>
> 📖 完整中文文档：[README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)

---

Efficient tool execution for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`): a skill that keeps the **model in the loop only for steps that need judgment**, moves deterministic work into one scripted pass (the Programmatic Tool Calling discipline), verifies results **locally** before reporting, and **stops unproductive retry loops** instead of burning tokens on them.

- Harness-agnostic scripts: **Python 3.8+, standard library only** — no pip install, no network.
- Installs as a native DeepSeek Harness **skill** (`SKILL.md` + helper scripts), and works in any harness that can run Python.

---

## Why: the three cost centers of long agent sessions

In long-running harness tasks the bill comes from three places:

1. **Repeated context cost** — every model turn re-carries the conversation: past messages, past tool calls, past tool *results*. Mechanical steps (copy this file, check that file, count those lines) each trigger a full round trip, and each round trip pays for the whole transcript again.
2. **Round-trip inflation** — a 20-file copy done step-by-step is ~40 model round trips; the model is present for steps that need no judgment.
3. **Verbose feedback** — raw tool output floods the context (hundreds of search hits, full test logs, whole-file dumps) even though the model only needs a status, a count, a diff, or an exception summary.

This project's answer, per cost center:

| Problem | Mechanism | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Mechanical steps trigger repeated model round trips | **Plan → batch execute → receipt**: one programmatic pass for the whole deterministic sequence | `scripts/batch_exec.py`, SKILL.md Layer 2 |
| Tool output floods the context | **Compressed feedback**: summary to stdout, full detail to a local log with stable ids, lazy on-demand deep reads | `scripts/search_summary.py`, `scripts/test_summary.py` |
| "Did my edit land?" stays unverified | **Local verification**: counts, sha256 tree hashes, diffs — evidence, not vibes | `scripts/verify_state.py`, plan `verify` section |
| Blind retries and repeated no-op edits | **Loop governance**: evidence hashes detect no-progress; retry limits stop the loop with a reason | `scripts/loop_guard.py` |
| Destructive ops run without scrutiny | **Approval gates**: remove/overwrite require explicit approval; dry-run first | `batch_exec.py` `--approve` / `--dry-run` |

## Architecture & workflow

```
            ┌──────────────────────────── model (judgment) ───────────────────────────┐
            │ 1. CLASSIFY  split task: deterministic (batchable) vs judgment-required │
            │ 2. PLAN      write plan JSON (or one program, if native PTC is on)      │
            └───────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                │ one hand-off
            ┌──────────────────────────── executor (deterministic) ───────────────────┐
            │ 3. PRE-CHECK  sources, destinations, policies                           │
            │ 4. EXECUTE    the whole planned sequence, continuously                  │
            │ 5. VERIFY     counts, hashes, diffs — locally, cheap-first              │
            └───────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                │ one receipt + evidence pointers
            ┌──────────────────────────── model (judgment) ───────────────────────────┐
            │ 6. REPORT     compact receipt only; deep reads are lazy (by log path)   │
            │ 7. GUARD      loop_guard check/record before every retry; honor STOP    │
            └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Native PTC note: DeepSeek Harness's Code Mode / programmatic tool calling does exactly this natively when enabled — **use it when available**. When it is not enabled, the same shape is achieved with the harness's ordinary file-write + command-execution tools (write the plan/script, run it, read only the summary). The skill documents both paths and the decision rules for each.

## Installation

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin (recommended)

The repository ships a `dsh.bundle` manifest (`package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml`), so it installs as a native plugin and the skill is registered automatically — no manual copying:

```bash
dsh plugin add github:LastTrainKing/deepseek-harness-batch-executor
```

The plugin registers the bundled `SKILL.md` through the `ctx.skills` provider seam; the helper scripts under `scripts/` ship inside the package and resolve relative to the skill directory. It is listed on the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) directory (category `skill`).

### As a plain skill (clone into the skill directories)

If you prefer not to use the plugin channel, DSH also scans skill directories directly (project-level wins over user-level):

```bash
# user-level (available in every project)
git clone https://github.com/LastTrainKing/deepseek-harness-batch-executor.git \
    ~/.dsh/skills/deepseek-harness-batch-executor

# or project-level (recommended for teams: commit the skill with the repo)
git clone https://github.com/LastTrainKing/deepseek-harness-batch-executor.git \
    <your-project>/.dsh/skills/deepseek-harness-batch-executor
```

Equivalent locations that DSH also scans: `<project>/.agents/skills/` and `~/.agents/skills/`. Custom directories can be registered via `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` (`skill-explorer.customSkillDirs`) or the `DSH_CUSTOM_SKILL_DIRS` environment variable. Skills are hot-reloaded — no restart needed.

### As plain scripts (any harness / CI)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/LastTrainKing/deepseek-harness-batch-executor.git
cd deepseek-harness-batch-executor
python scripts/batch_exec.py --plan examples/sample-plan.json   # try it
```

## Usage

### 1. Batch execution with verification — `scripts/batch_exec.py`

```bash
python scripts/batch_exec.py --plan plan.json [--dry-run] [--approve] \
                             [--log-dir DIR] [--fail-fast] [--json]
```

`plan.json` (see [`examples/sample-plan.json`](examples/sample-plan.json)):

```json
{
  "plan_id": "copy-configs",
  "overwrite": "if-different",
  "operations": [
    {"id": "op-1", "op": "copy", "src": "templates/a.conf", "dst": "build/a.conf"},
    {"id": "op-2", "op": "mkdir", "path": "build/out"},
    {"id": "op-3", "op": "expect", "path": "build/a.conf", "expect": {"exists": true}},
    {"id": "op-4", "op": "remove", "path": "build/tmp", "requires_approval": true}
  ],
  "verify": [
    {"type": "count", "pattern": "build/*.conf", "expect": 8},
    {"type": "tree-hash", "src": "templates", "dst": "build"}
  ]
}
```

Sample receipt (real output from running `examples/sample-plan.json` against 8 template files):

```
[receipt] plan=copy-configs status=success elapsed_ms=56
counts: total=10 ok=10 already_satisfied=0 failed=0 refused=0 planned=0
operations:
  op-1                     mkdir    ok                 created directory: build/configs
  op-2                     copy     ok                 copied templates/app.conf -> build/configs/app.conf (14 bytes)
  ... (op-3 .. op-9: copies, all ok)
  op-10                    expect   ok                 expectation satisfied: build/configs/db.conf
verify:
  count        pass  glob 'build/configs/*.conf' matched 8 file(s), expected 8
  tree-hash    pass  trees identical (8 file(s))
full log: .dsh-batch-logs/copy-configs-20261017T043700Z.json
```

Key properties: idempotent (`if-different` reports `already_satisfied` instead of re-copying), verification is content-hash based (not "the command returned 0"), every run writes a full JSON audit log, and exit codes are explicit (`0` success, `2` partial

plugins.description: DSH plugin: permanent Delete-session action for the session menu (DSH only ships archive)
plugins.readme_text:
# @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-session-delete

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

Adds a **Delete session** action to the session "…" menu of DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` only ships **archive** (a soft delete: hidden, but all data is kept). This plugin fills the gap — one click **permanently deletes** a session together with its on-disk data.

## Features

- In the session row's "…" menu, right after the built-in Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive, a new **Delete session** entry appears.
- Clicking it opens a confirmation dialog (showing the session title); confirming invokes the host-side delete.
- Deleting cleans up three data locations:
  1. The session itself: `~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/`
  2. The projection cache: `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<session-id>.json`
  3. The session's registration in the workspace index (`sessionIds` / archive / pin marks)
- After a successful delete, the open UI **needs no refresh** — the row disappears via the `api-session/removed` event.
- **Auto-repairs the default workspace**: DSH's built-in "Delete workspace", if it ever deleted the default one, leaves dangling pointers — its sessions fall into "Ungrouped" and new sessions can no longer be created. On startup this plugin rebuilds the registration and re-homes the sessions **for the default workspace only** (identified via `defaultWorkspaceId` or the last remembered path). Other workspaces you deleted on purpose are not "revived".

## Safety

- **Running sessions refuse deletion**: it uses the same `workspace/session-activity` detection as DSH's archive. Only genuinely running work (an in-flight conversation turn, background jobs, …) is blocked with "this session is running"; idle old sessions (even if still kept alive in DSH's memory) delete normally.
- Deletion goes through DSH's own workspace-registry write paths (`detachSession` / `unarchiveSession` / `unpinSession`), so persisted state stays consistent.
- Routes are same-origin fenced; only requests coming from the DSH UI itself are accepted.

## Install

This plugin targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and newer `0.2.x` releases (currently verified on `0.2.1-rc.2`), and is linked into the `desktop` profile as a local directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/dsh-session-delete"
```

Then **restart DSH** for it to take effect.

You can also edit `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` manually:

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-session-delete": "link:/absolute/path/dsh-session-delete"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ... existing ...
        "@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-session-delete"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Then run `pnpm install` in the profile directory and restart DSH.

## Usage

1. In the session list on the left, hover a session and click its "…".
2. Choose **Delete session**.
3. Click **Delete** in the confirmation dialog.

> ⚠️ Deletion is **permanent and irreversible**. Make sure the session really is no longer needed.

## Limitations / notes

- This is a community plugin built on DSH's public extension points (the session-menu slot `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` plus host-side file/registry cleanup). If a future DSH release ships an official "delete session" API, prefer that.
- Running sessions refuse deletion; if you really need one gone, stop it first (finish/archive its work) and then delete.
- The full-text search index is a rebuildable read model of DSH's; right after a delete there may be briefly stale results until the next rebuild.

## License

MIT

# dsh-mcp-manager

在 dsh 桌面版 GUI 中查看并管理当前 profile 的 MCP 服务器
（即 `cordis.patch.yml` 中 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 的 insert 行）。

## 这是什么

dsh 的 MCP 客户端把每个 MCP 服务器声明为一条 profile patch 的 insert 行。
官方设置页对这类 union 行没有感知，手工改文件又容易踩坑（被顶层 override 行遮蔽等）。
本插件补上这一缺口：

- **Host 半**（`lib/index.js`）：在 dsh 的 `/api` 认证通道下挂一条 fetch 路由
  `/api/mcp-config`，提供 `list` / `save` / `remove` 三种操作。写入时直接用
  yaml 的 Document API 在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里就地改写目标行，因此注释、缩进、
  折行与 `!!js` 表达式全部原样保留；落盘走 dsh 自己的原子写 + 文件锁。
- **Client 半**（`lib/client.js`）：桌面 GUI 中的「MCP 服务器」页面。可列出当前
  profile 的全部 MCP 服务器，查看其 serverName / 传输方式 / 目标 / 工具数 / 运行状态，
  点「新增服务器」按表单填写后直接追加一行（行 id 默认由 serverName 派生，可手改），
  编辑并保存配置（热重载，无需重启），启用或停用，从 `{"mcpServers": {...}}` 片段
  批量导入，以及删除（删除前自动备份原文到同目录 `.bak`）。

界面文案内置中文与英文两套，跟随 dsh 主题 token 适配外观。

## 仓库结构

```
dsh-mcp-manager/
├── package.json          # bundle 元数据，声明 dsh.bundle.patch 与 dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 把本插件作为一条 Loader 行插入 profile
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # Host 半：/api/mcp-config 路由与 patch 行读写
│   └── client.js         # Client 半：GUI「MCP 服务器」页面
├── node_modules/         # 安装时由 pnpm 装入（已 gitignore，不入库）
├── .gitignore
├── LICENSE               # MIT
└── README.md
```

依赖全部写在 `package.json` 里，仓库不携带 `node_modules/`：

| 依赖 | 声明位置 | 由谁提供 |
|---|---|---|
| `yaml` | `dependencies` | 安装插件时 pnpm 装进 profile `node_modules` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write` | `peerDependencies` + `devDependencies` | 运行中的 dsh 运行时闭包（同一份实例，不与宿主重复加载） |

`dsh-atomic-write` 声明为 peer 而非 dependency，是让它由宿主供给单一实例，
插件仓库因此既不需要、也不应该携带 `node_modules`。

## 安装与启用

本插件是 dsh bundle，由 dsh 桌面版按 `package.json` 中的 `dsh` 字段识别并加载：

- `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，由 Host 半作为一条 Loader 行注册。
- `dsh.client` 声明 `platform: web` 与 inject 目标，由 dsh 客户端模块系统把
  `lib/client.js` 作为浏览器半侧送出。

通过 dsh 插件管理器或 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本仓库地址>` 安装：pnpm 会按
`dependencies` 自动装上 `yaml`（peer 由宿主供给，pnpm 不装）。加载后在左侧导航出现「MCP 服务器」。

> 本地开发若用 `link:` 挂载源码目录，pnpm 不会安装本插件的 `dependencies`；此时需在插件
> 目录内执行一次 `pnpm install` 得到本地 `node_modules`（已 gitignore），解析时插件自身
> 的 `node_modules` 优先级最高。用 `github:` / tarball 地址安装则依赖自动装进 profile，
> 无需此步。

## 能力边界

- 支持 `stdio` 与 `streamable-http` 两种传输方式的查看、编辑与新增。
- 新增：列表页右上角「新增服务器」→ 填表单（可写一段说明注释，留空则自动生成
  时间注释）→ 保存即在 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加一个 `- insert:` 块，无需手工
  编辑文件。注释只在新建时写入，改写既有行不会动它。
- 删除：删除前回报「会一并删掉的注释行数」供确认，并把原文备份到同目录 `.bak`。
- 写入只改目标行（就地逐键合并），注释、缩进、折行与 `!!js` 表达式保持原样。

## 许可证

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: Author, inspect, and export editable presentation decks one slide at a time.
plugins.readme_text:
# DeckCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![DeckCraft Use — editable presentations from a coding agent](assets/official-logo.png)

> Author, inspect and export a real presentation from your agent host — one slide at a time, with the editable source deck kept as the deliverable.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](https://github.com/full-aigc-plugins/deckcraft-plugin/releases)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-10-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20tools-33-00A67E)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`deckcraft` lets an agent host drive the DeckCraft engine through a bundled stdio MCP server and a set of presentation skills, so a request ends with an editable `.deckcraft` deck plus the exports you asked for. The plugin owns skill routing, the same-session editor bridge and package pinning. It does not replace DeckCraft, its engine, or the host runtime.

| Property | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| Plugin ID | `deckcraft` |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.4` |
| Status | Development preview; production promotion blocked, all-host acceptance open |
| Editor runtime | Node.js 24, started from `ui/bootstrap.mjs` |
| Upstream reference | DeckCraft `0.3.0` (`d0e57d7e25f9852179cc66be12dd6188f1c05535`) |
| Optional CLI | `deckcraft-cli`, if your host already has it on `PATH` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 24 on `PATH`; the bundled stdio MCP server runs on it.
- Network access on the first editor launch. The plugin downloads and verifies the pinned editor archive; a complete release ZIP already contains it, so no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are required.
- A `deckcraft-cli` installation only if you want the native CLI path. The plugin never installs or upgrades it.
- A host that supports plugins or stdio MCP. Embedded panels additionally require MCP Apps or a built-in browser.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add deckcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

Restart the host, open a new task, and ask DeckCraft to start a deck.

### Other host manifests

| Host | Manifest | Path base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Agent Plugins 1.0.0 | `plugin.json`, `mcp.json` | `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` |
| Codex | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `.codex-plugin/mcp.json` | plugin root relative to `cwd` |
| Claude Code | `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.mcp.json` | `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` |

Kimi (`kimi.plugin.json`), DeepSeek Harness (`dsh/`) and the WorkBuddy example (`hosts/workbuddy/mcp.json`) are also present. `hosts/native-cli/mcp.json` shows the optional `deckcraft-cli mcp` server instead of the bundled editor.

## Quick start

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Install plugin] --> B[Restart and open a task]
    B --> C[open_editor]
    C --> D{editor_status ready?}
    D -->|No| C
    D -->|Yes| E[new_presentation]
    E --> F[add_slide / add_shape / insert_chart]
    F --> G[inspect_slide]
    G --> H[save_presentation / export]
```

1. Open the editor with an explicit `workspace` argument.
2. Start a deck with `new_presentation`, or open an existing one with `open_presentation`.
3. Read `list_commands` before complex edits; command IDs and `enabled` state come from the live registry.
4. After each block of edits, call `inspect_document` or `inspect_slide`, and `render_slide` when you need a picture.
5. Save the `.deckcraft` source, then export. Reopen the source to confirm the slides are still editable.

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Pitch deck with problem, evidence and ask | `deckcraft-pitch-deck` | Slide-per-message deck with speaker notes |
| Weekly or status report | `deckcraft-weekly-report` | Progress, risk and next-step slides |
| Training courseware | `deckcraft-training-slides` | Explanation, example, exercise and recap slides |
| Data narrative | `deckcraft-data-story` + `insert_chart` | Chart bound to your data with title and labels |
| Brand template reuse | `deckcraft-brand-template` | Master-styled slides, consistent layouts |
| Redesign an existing deck | `deckcraft-slide-redesign` | Restructured deck, original retained |
| Option comparison | `deckcraft-option-comparison` + `insert_table` | Editable comparison table with units and sources |
| Delivery | `save_presentation`, `export` | Editable source plus PPTX, PDF or image output |

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
| :--- | :--- |
| `deckcraft-use` | Main entry: create, modify, inspect or export a deck through the connected MCP or an installed CLI |
| `deckcraft-editor` | Open the real editor in the host and keep agent edits on the same page |
| `deckcraft-pitch-deck` | Problem, solution, evidence and ask for a project pitch |
| `deckcraft-weekly-report` | Progress, issues, metrics and next-week plan |
| `deckcraft-training-slides` | Explanation, examples, exercises and recap |
| `deckcraft-data-story` | Data conclusion and business interpretation, with chart plans |
| `deckcraft-brand-template` | Master style and recurring layouts for a brand |
| `deckcraft-slide-redesign` | Restructure and visually improve an existing deck |
| `deckcraft-option-comparison` | Cost, lead time and risk compared in an editable table |
| `deckcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Step-by-step recipes for metric briefing, comparison, flow, risk matrix, trend, training Q&A and handoff |

Skills come from the independent `deckcraft-skills` source and are pinned by `scenario-candidates.json` with per-skill SHA-256 digests. They carry scenario knowledge and execution contracts, not a second engine.

## MCP tools

One bundled server, `deckcraft-editor`, speaking **stdio**. The local HTTP listener only serves the editor page and its same-session bridge. The catalogue exposes 33 tools: 28 agent-callable tools and 5 `_editor_*` bridge tools the panel uses internally.

| Family | Tools | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Session | `open_editor`, `open_browser_editor`, `editor_status` | Open the editor and confirm that it attached |
| Discovery | `list_commands`, `call_app` | List live commands; `call_app` reaches app-level control methods (desktop app only) |
| Command gateway | `run_command`, `batch` | Run one command, or an ordered batch with explicit failure semantics |
| Deck management | `new_presentation`, `open_presentation`, `save_presentation`, `export` | Create, open, save and export |
| Slides | `add_slide`, `go_to_slide`, `inspect_slide`, `render_slide` | Add, navigate, read and render one slide |
| Content | `add_shape`, `add_text_box`, `set_text`, `insert_picture`, `insert_table`, `insert_chart` | Place and edit the objects a slide is made of |
| Inspection | `inspect_document` | Titles, page count, objects and text of the whole deck |
| Interaction | `select`, `select_tool`, `pointer`, `key`, `type_text`, `screenshot` | Drive the same paths a mouse and keyboard would; `screenshot` captures the whole window and needs the desktop app |

## Configuration

| Setting | Where | Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `workspace` argument | `open_editor` / `open_browser_editor` | Binds the task folder; paths outside it are refused |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` | stdio MCP `env` | Use the bundled editor only; no download attempt |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_CACHE_DIR` | Environment | Absolute directory for verified editor archives |
| `CRAFT_WORKSPACE_ROOT` | Host MCP conf

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: Russian UI localization, element scaling (80-220%), pixel-art drawing (pixel_art), and outbound proxy choice with its own settings page - HTTP(S)/SOCKS5, latency and exit-country checks (proxy_switch).
plugins.readme_text:
# rus-image-percent-gen

**Один плагин DeepSeek Harness, который делает шесть вещей:**

| Что | Как это выглядит |
|---|---|
| **Русский интерфейс** | перевод всей оболочки (2310 строк), включается автоматически |
| **Масштаб элементов** | кнопка `A+` / `A−` в подвале панели, от 80 % до **220 %** (шаг 5 %, выше 160 % — 10 %) |
| **Рисование** | инструмент `pixel_art`: холст 4×4…256×256, покраска по пикселю, предпросмотр ×5/×3, экспорт PNG |
| **Прокси** | инструмент `proxy_switch`, **переключатель в подвале панели** и **своя страница в настройках**: адрес по частям, HTTP(S)/SOCKS5, проверка по пингу со страной выхода |
| **Тариф** | строка под полем ввода: «Тариф: обычный» или «Тариф: пик ×2» — по системному времени |
| **Улучшения** | предохранитель от случайной отправки, копирование переписки правой кнопкой, тёмная тема по расписанию — и своя страница «Улучшения» в настройках |

Пример результата: ![сердце 16×16](docs/example-heart-6x.png)

Английская версия — [ниже](#english). Как выложить плагин, чтобы его скачали другие —
[PUBLISH.md](PUBLISH.md).

Установка одной строкой:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Pro12447890/rus-image-percent-gen
```

---

## Рисование: инструмент `pixel_art`

| `action` | Что делает |
|---|---|
| `help` | отдаёт эту инструкцию целиком (`lang: "ru"` или `"en"`) |
| `new` | создаёт/очищает холст: `width`, `height` (4…256), необязательный `background` |
| `pixels` | красит отдельные пиксели: `[{x, y, color, alpha?}]` |
| `draw` | рисует ASCII-сетку по палитре: `rows` + `palette` (символ → цвет) |
| `fill` | заливает прямоугольник `{x, y, w, h, color, alpha?}` |
| `dump` | возвращает холст сеткой символов и легендой палитры (текстом) |
| `preview` | возвращает холст картинкой PNG (по умолчанию ×5, для крупных ×3) |
| `save` | пишет итоговый PNG (1:1), с `scale` — ещё и увеличенную копию |

Цвета: `#rgb`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `"r,g,b[,a]"`, имя (`red`, `teal`, `skin`)
или массив `[r,g,b,a]`. Альфа — 0…255.

Несколько холстов сразу — через необязательное имя `canvas`.

## Прокси: инструмент `proxy_switch`

**Прокси по умолчанию НЕ вписан и НЕ включён.** Ни адреса, ни логина, ни пароля: пока
пользователь не задаст свой, всё идёт напрямую, как будто инструмента нет. Это сделано
намеренно — чужой прокси в общем пакете не нужен никому.

**Части адреса вводятся раздельно** — у каждого прокси они свои: `protocol`, `host`,
`port`, `user`, `password`. Можно и одной строкой (`proxy`), если так удобнее.

| `action` | Что делает |
|---|---|
| `status` | текущий маршрут: режим, адрес (логин скрыт), список обхода, кандидаты, результат последней проверки, доступен ли `undici`, что в переменных окружения |
| `check` | **проверка по пингу**: идёт через каждого кандидата настоящим запросом и показывает время ответа, внешний IP и **страну**; `"choose": true` — переключиться на быстрейшего |
| `set` | включить свой прокси — **по частям** (`host`, `port`, `user`, `password`, `protocol`) или одной строкой `proxy` |
| `env` | взять адрес из переменных окружения (`HTTPS_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY`/`ALL_PROXY`) |
| `off` | вернуться к прямому выходу |
| `help` | отдать инструкцию (`lang: "ru"` или `"en"`) |

Поддерживаются **HTTP(S) и SOCKS5** (у SOCKS5 нет списка обхода). Есть **отдельная страница настроек** в интерфейсе: Настройки → Прокси.
Логин и пароль в ответах скрываются (`http://***@host:8080`). Переключение действует
сразу для всех внутрипроцессных запросов (модели, поиск, HTTP-MCP) и, если не выключить
`export_env`, уходит в переменные дочерних процессов (`curl`/`git`, stdio-MCP).

```json
{"action":"set","protocol":"http","host":"proxy.example.com","port":8080,
 "user":"логин","password":"пароль","noProxy":["localhost","api.deepseek.com"]}
{"action":"set","proxy":"http://user:password@proxy.example.com:8080"}
{"action":"check","targets":[
   {"name":"Домашний","host":"proxy-a.example.com","port":8080,"user":"u","password":"p"},
   {"name":"Рабочий","host":"proxy-b.example.com","port":3128}]}
{"action":"check","choose":true}
```

Чтобы адрес применялся при каждом запуске DSH, а кандидатов было удобно проверять
по пингу, впишите их в конфиг записи плагина (**по умолчанию там пусто**):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: rus-image-percent-gen
      name: 'rus-image-percent-gen'
      config:
        proxy:
          enabled: true
          url: 'http://user:password@proxy-a.example.com:8080'   # включается при запуске
          candidates:                                            # что проверяет check
            - { name: 'Домашний', protocol: http, host: proxy-a.example.com, port: 8080, user: u, password: p }
            - 'http://user:password@proxy-b.example.com:8080'
          noProxy: ['localhost', '127.0.0.1']
          exportEnv: true
```

Ответ `check` выглядит так:

```
Проверка прокси (2):
1. Домашний — http://***@proxy-a.example.com:8080 — живой, 412 мс, внешний IP 38.154.185.97, страна United States (US)
2. Рабочий — http://***@proxy-b.example.com:3128 — нет ответа за 5000 мс (no answer within 5000 ms)
Быстрейший: Домашний — http://***@proxy-a.example.com:8080 (412 мс, United States).
```

Если в профиле уже стоит отдельный плагин прокси с карточкой настроек (например
`@memef1f1y/dsh-plugin-proxy`) — держите включённым только один: оба пишут один и тот же
глобальный диспетчер.

Для внутрипроцессного прокси нужен пакет `undici` (объявлен в зависимостях, при
установке из npm ставится сам). Если его нет, `set`/`env`/`check` честно скажут об этом.

## Тариф: строка под полем ввода

Под полем ввода, рядом со скоростью и попаданием в кэш, плагин показывает **действующий
тариф**: «Тариф: обычный» или «Тариф: пик ×2» — по системному времени пользователя.

У DeepSeek цена в пиковые часы ровно вдвое выше, чем в обычные: пик — **понедельник–пятница,
01:00–04:00 и 06:00–10:00 UTC**, всё остальное время (включая выходные) — половина цены.
Плагин переводит эти границы в местное время: подсказка при наведении показывает окна
(например, `04:00–07:00 · 09:00–13:00` для Москвы) и время следующего переключения. Строка
обновляется сама каждые 20 секунд — переход через полночь, начало пика и выходные видны
без перезагрузки.

Китайские государственные праздники, когда действует обычный тариф, не учитываются:
их список задаётся календарём, а не расписанием.

```text
● Тариф: обычный        — сейчас, суббота
● Тариф: пик ×2         — понедельник, 04:00–07:00 и 09:00–13:00 (МСК)
```

## Улучшения: предохранитель, копирование, тёмная тема

![Плашка предохранителя](docs/example-guard.png)

**Предохранитель от пустой траты токенов.** Если в поле ввода меньше 5 букв (порог
настраивается), перед отправкой появляется плашка «Точно ли вы хотите отправить?» с
кнопками «Отмена» и «Отправить». Спрашиваем не чаще одного раза в 5 минут — иначе
переписка из «ок» и «да» превращалась бы в сплошные вопросы. Работает и для Enter, и
для кнопки отправки; «Отправить» в плашке повторяет ровно то действие, которое вы
только что сделали.

**Копирование по правой кнопке.** Правый клик по сообщению — меню из двух пунктов:
«Копировать сообщение» и «Копировать всю переписку». В копию не попадают кнопки
действий и скрытые подсказки, а в полной переписке у сообщений стоят роли «Вы» и «ИИ».

**Тёмная тема по расписанию.** Задайте окно «Тёмная с … до …» по местному времени —
оно может переходить через полночь (например, 20:00 → 08:00). Внутри окна включается
тёмная тема, снаружи — светлая, а переход растягивается на 10 секунд (настраивается;
0 — переключать сразу). Расписание проверяется раз в 20 секунд и при возврате во
вкладку; если тему выбрать вручную, плагин не спорит до следующей границы окна.

Все три ручки — на странице **Настройки → Улучшения**: включение, порог букв, частота
вопроса, окно тёмной темы и длительность перехода.

## Установка

```sh
# из локальной папки
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <путь-к-папке-плагина>

# или из npm / git, когда пакет опубликован
dsh plugin --profile desktop add rus-image-percent-gen
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Pro12447890/rus-image-percent-gen
```

В интерфейсе DSH то же самое делается через **Настройки → Плагины** (установка
бандла). После установки плагин виден в перечне бандлов профиля, а инструмент
`pix

plugins.description: Command resolution forensics: which file a command actually runs, what it shadows, and whether the copies agree.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-which

**Command resolution forensics for DeepSeek Harness.** When you type `node`, a shell answers with a rule that is longer than people remember — PATH order, then PATHEXT on Windows or the executable bit elsewhere, with builtins short-circuiting the whole thing. `dsh-which` reports what that rule actually decided, what it shadowed, what shape PATH itself is in, and whether the copies behind one name agree on a version.

Every failure it names is silent. The command runs; it is just not the one you meant.

```
dsh-which · node
  winner:   C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.EXE
  kind:     native binary
  from:     PATH[0]  C:\Program Files\nodejs
  size:     84MB
  modified: 2025-11-03T09:14:00.000Z
  version:  v24.13.0  (--version)
  searched: 9 PATH entries

  shadowed — 1 other directory holds this name:
    PATH[6]  C:\Users\me\scoop\shims\node.EXE  native binary  84MB
      ↳ reports v20.11.1

  ⚠ the copies behind this name report different versions — the one that runs is the one at PATH[0].
```

That last block is the whole reason this exists. Two Node installations, one on PATH, and nothing anywhere tells you which one a command gets.

## Why not just run `which`

1. **`which` does not exist on Windows**, and where it does exist it answers a narrower question. It reports the file it found; it does not report the file it skipped.
2. **`which` inherits the rules under investigation.** Shelling out to a resolver to explain resolution means trusting the resolver you are debugging. The rules here are reimplemented as pure functions over an injected filesystem (`lib/resolve.js`), so they are testable against fixtures instead of against whatever is installed on the test machine.
3. **Shell builtins are not files.** `which cd` on most systems walks every PATH entry to report something that has nothing to do with what runs. This plugin says `builtin` and explains that PATH was never consulted.
4. **The interesting output is the shadowed copy.** "What runs" is one line. "What else answers to this name, and why is it not running" is the diagnosis — a stale global install behind a fresh local one, a `.cmd` shim in front of a real binary, a file that exists but was never made executable.
5. **Reporting is the whole job.** There is no PATH-editing tool here. A plugin that silently rewrites PATH is a plugin that breaks a machine.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/11111353535/dsh-which
```

From a checkout instead of a git host, pass the absolute path:

```sh
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-which
```

Optional configuration, in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: which
  name: 'dsh-which'
  config:
    probeByDefault: false        # run a version probe on every resolve
    probeShadowedByDefault: false # probe the shadowed copies too
    probeTimeoutMs: 4000
    maxSweepFiles: 400
    runtimes: [node, npm, pnpm, python, git]
```

| key | default | what it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `probeTimeoutMs` | `4000` | How long a version probe may take before it is abandoned. |
| `probeByDefault` | `false` | Probe every resolve without being asked. Slower, explains more. |
| `probeShadowedByDefault` | `false` | Probe the shadowed copies too. Multiplies the process spawns. |
| `maxSweepFiles` | `400` | Files examined in one sweep, so a huge directory cannot stall a session. |
| `runtimes` | node, npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, python, python3, pip, pip3, uv, git, rg, fd, make, pwsh, bash | Commands the environment report resolves. |

Probing is off by default because it spawns processes, and a diagnostic that costs four seconds on every call is a diagnostic people turn off.

## Tools

### `which_resolve`

Resolve one command and report what runs, what it shadowed, and — on request — what each copy reports as its version.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | string, **required** | A name (`node`) or a path (`./build.sh`, `C:\tools\x.exe`). |
| `probe` | boolean | Run the winner with a version flag. |
| `probeShadowed` | boolean | Probe the shadowed copies too, so versions can be compared. |

A name that resolves to nothing is an answer, not an error:

```
dsh-which · build
  not found
  the name exists on PATH but nothing with that name is runnable
  searched: 45 PATH entries

  the name exists, but nothing with it can run:
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        build  not runnable  1KB
        … and 37 more
```

The count is the finding; the enumeration is the evidence, and past eight directories the evidence stops being read. The lines that save an hour are the second and third: the name *is* on PATH, the file simply cannot run. On POSIX that means no executable bit — a shell walks right past it into later PATH entries, or fails.

An explicit path never consults PATH, and the report says so:

```
dsh-which · /repo/scripts/build.sh
  winner:   /repo/scripts/build.sh
  kind:     script
  from:     given as a path, PATH was not consulted
  size:     2.3KB
  searched: 0 PATH entries
```

### `which_path`

The shape of PATH itself: every entry in resolution order, with duplicates, entries whose directory is gone, and entries containing an unexpanded variable.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showNoise` | boolean | Include `/usr/bin`, `/bin` and friends, omitted by default as uninformative. |
| `limit` | number | Maximum entries listed. Defaults to 40. |

```
dsh-which · PATH
  9 entries · 8 unique directories
  1 duplicate entry · 1 dead entry

  entries, in resolution order:
    [ 0] C:\Program Files\nodejs
    [ 1] C:\Users\me\AppData\Roaming\npm
    [ 2] C:\Windows\system32
    [ 3] C:\Windows
    [ 4] C:\tools\git\cmd
    [ 5] C:\Program Files\nodejs  — dup of [0]
    [ 6] C:\Users\me\scoop\shims
    [ 7] D:\old-python\Scripts  — missing
    [ 8] C:\Users\me\bin

  Duplicates are usually an installer that prepends itself on every run. Harmless until you edit "the" entry and two copies of it remain.

  Dead entries are skipped silently by every shell, so an uninstalled toolchain leaves a hole that only shows up when its command fails.
```

A dead entry is invisible by construction: shells skip it without a word, so the hole only surfaces later as "command not found" for something that was there yesterday. An unexpanded `%USERPROFILE%` is worse — it can never resolve, no matter what the variable is set to.

### `which_env`

One page describing the command environment: platform, shell, working directory, PATH findings, PATHEXT, and where each common runtime resolves from.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | number | Maximum runtimes listed. Defaults to 30. |

```
dsh-which · environment
  platform: win32  arch x64  node v24.13.0
  shell:    pwsh.exe  (C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe)
  cwd:      C:\repo
  PATH:     9 entries · 8 unique
            1 duplicate · 1 dead
  PATHEXT:  .COM .EXE .BAT .CMD

  resolved runtimes:
    · node  C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.EXE
    · npm  C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.CMD
    · pnpm  C:\Users\me\AppData\Roaming\npm\pnpm.CMD
    · git  C:\tools\git\cmd\git.EXE
    ✗ python  not found

  1 runtime(s) exist in more than one place on PATH: node
```

The shell line matters more than it looks. `pwsh` and `cmd` disagree about builtins and about `.ps1`, so a report that names the wrong shell is a report nobody should trust.

### `which_sweep`

Sweep a directory of scripts and report, for each name that looks like a command, whether the copy in *that* directory is the one that would run.

| parameter | type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `directory` | string, **required** | Absolute, or relative to the workspace. |
| `limit` | number | Maximum rows listed. Defaults to 60. |

```
dsh-which · sweep C:\repo\scripts
  3 command(s)
  1 resolve outside this directory (shown with ↪)
  1 do not resolve at all

  ↪ build.cmd  → C:\tools\build\build.cmd
  · deploy.cmd  C:\repo\scripts\deploy.cmd
  ✗ smoke.cmd  does not resolve

  A ↪ means a copy in this di

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tool-planner

A DSH skill that helps non-programmers plan and build a tool by interview.

It walks the user through how they do the task by hand today, one plain-language step at a time, turning each step into a flowchart node. Then a short round of automation questions, a plain-language plan, and explicit approval before building.

## Install

**Desktop app:** open **Plugins → Add Plugin**, paste the source below, click install, then restart the app.

```
github:WasifAlamDip/dsh-fde-tool-planner
```

**Terminal:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:WasifAlamDip/dsh-fde-tool-planner
```

If `dsh` is not on your PATH, put `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` in place of `dsh`. Restart dsh after installing.

To pin a release, add a tag: `github:WasifAlamDip/dsh-fde-tool-planner#v0.1.0`.

## Usage

Describe what you want in 3–4 lines. Answer in plain language — no technical knowledge needed.

## Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tool-planner
```

## Credits

Built by [Wasif Alam Dip](https://github.com/WasifAlamDip).

## License

MIT

# dsh-session-cleaner

A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** plugin — host half and Web client half in one bundle — that adds two
things to the DSH Web GUI:

1. **Delete a conversation** from the sidebar session menu, with a confirmation dialog.
2. **Quote / Ask from the right-click menu** — select text in a chat message, then right-click. The
   plugin takes over the context menu and shows **Copy / Quote / Ask**, with Copy first, exactly where
   the native menu item used to be:
   - **Copy** writes the selection to the clipboard (the same action as before, now drawn by us).
   - **Quote** inserts a Markdown quote block (role + turn metadata) into the composer.
   - **Ask** sends the selection plus your question to a *concurrent subagent* and streams the answer
     into the right sidebar, without interrupting the main conversation.

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

---

## Features

| Surface | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | **Delete session** — stops a running session (flush + detach), detaches it from the workspace registry, invalidates its projection cache, physically removes the session directory, cleans its spill directory, cascades to its `origin: subagent` children (fork branches are never cascaded), then broadcasts `api-session/removed`. |
| `shell.overlay` | Selection **right-click menu**: **Copy** (clipboard) / **Quote** (insert into the composer) / **Ask** (concurrent subagent question). The menu is drawn by the plugin because the desktop app builds its native context menu in the Electron main process, which a renderer plugin cannot extend; `preventDefault()` on `contextmenu` keeps the native menu from popping. |
| `sidebar.right.pane.tab` | **Follow-up** tab: streams the ask subagent's answer (reasoning + text) in the right sidebar. |

### Ask reuses one subagent

Every question does **not** spawn a new subagent. The plugin keeps a single continuable subagent
labelled `ask` per parent session and delivers the next question to it (discovering the existing one
through the official `subagents.listChildren()` catalog, so it survives a host restart).

### Scoped auto-compaction for the ask subagent

Because the reused `ask` subagent's context grows with every question, the host registers its own
`agent/pre-step` listener that calls `ctx.compaction.compactIfNeeded(agent, "pressure", signal)`
**only for this plugin's own ask subagents**. Global automatic compaction stays off
(`compaction-basic` is mounted with `auto: false`) — the main conversation is unaffected.

---

## Install

The plugin is a normal DSH bundle. Add it to your profile's `package.json`:

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@local/dsh-session-cleaner-host": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-session-cleaner-host"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // …
        "@local/dsh-session-cleaner-host"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

The package name must be used consistently in three places:

- `package.json` → `name`
- `client.js` → `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: "…" })`
- the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` entry

Then add the compaction backend to your profile patch layer
(`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`), which is applied **after** every bundle layer:

```yaml
# Compaction backend for the ask subagent's scoped auto-compaction.
# `auto: false` keeps GLOBAL automatic compaction off; the plugin calls
# ctx.compaction.compactIfNeeded() itself, scoped to its own ask subagents.
- id: compaction-basic
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic"
  disabled: false
  config:
    auto: false
```

> Keep this row in the **profile** patch, not in this package's bundle patch: installing a plugin
> must not silently enable another package for the whole profile.

Restart DSH after changing host-side code, then reload the page. Verify which build is live:

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/dsh-session-cleaner/version
# {"ok":true,"name":"dsh-session-cleaner","build":"…","features":{…}}
```

---

## Usage

**Quote / Ask**

1. Select some text in a chat message.
2. Right-click inside the selection.
3. The context menu opens with **Copy / Quote / Ask** (Copy first, then a separator).
4. *Quote* appends a quoted block to the composer. *Ask* swaps the menu for a question box; send it
   and the **Follow-up** tab opens in the right sidebar with the streamed answer.

Right-clicking in the composer, or right-clicking without a selection, keeps the normal system menu
(cut / paste / select all).

**Delete a conversation**

Sidebar session row → `⋯` → **Delete session**. Deleting the currently open session stops it and
switches the page to a new session.

---

## HTTP API

All routes are served by the plugin's host half (same-origin, browser cookie auth):

| Method | Path | Body | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/api/dsh-session-cleaner/version` | — | Which build is live (diagnostics). |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-cleaner/ask` | `{ sessionId, text }` | Deliver a question to the reused `ask` subagent, creating it once if needed. |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-cleaner/delete-session` | `{ sessionId }` | Delete a whole session (and cascade to its subagent children). |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-cleaner/delete-subagent` | `{ childId, parentId }` | Delete one direct subagent child. Guarded by a lineage check. |
| `POST` | `/api/dsh-session-cleaner/terminate-children` | `{ sessionId }` | Drain every continuable descendant of a session. |

---

## Design notes and hard-won constraints

These are the constraints that shape the implementation. Several of them were established by reading
the shipped DSH sources, and getting any of them wrong produces silent data loss.

1. **DSH exposes no "delete a session" API.** `sessions`, `sessionPersistence`,
   `sessionProjectionCache` and `sessionController` are all append-only; the persistence seam documents
   *"Nothing deletes session files … the seam has no deletion API."* This plugin therefore performs
   deliberate on-disk surgery — and compensates with strict identity checks.
2. **Never rewrite another session's log.** The plugin originally rewrote the parent log to drop a
   `subagent/catalog` row. Session logs are append-only and may be written concurrently by the host, so
   a read → filter → atomic-rename could truncate a conversation. `rewriteParentLog` now defaults to
   **`false`**.
3. **Session directory lookup is identity-verified.** Any candidate directory must yield a log whose
   header `id` equals the requested session id; the plugin never falls back to guessing.
4. **`subagent/catalog` is append-only.** There is no supported way to remove a row, and removing the
   child's session behind a live row produces a dangling entry. The plugin does not touch catalog rows.
5. **Subagent operations are lineage-guarded.** `delete-subagent` refuses unless
   `header.parentSession === parentId && header.origin === "subagent"`, and refuses
   `childId === parentId` — without that check, "delete the subagent" can delete the conversation you
   are looking at.
6. **Compaction needs a *live idle* agent.** `compaction.compactNow(agent, signal)` takes a
   `ManualCompactAgentContext` (it needs `runMaintenance()`), but a continuable subagent is **not
   resident after its turn settles**. There is therefore no supported way to compact a *finished*
   subagent on demand; compaction only works at `agent/pre-step`, while the turn is open and the agent
   is alive. That is why the plugin hooks `agent/pre-step` instead of offering a button.
7. **Self-contained by design.** The host half imports **only Node builtins** — no `@deepseek-ai/*`
   runtime dependency, so the plugin cannot shadow the official packages in a profile's
   `node_modules`. `package.json` declares no dependencies at all.
8. **Selections are quoted verbatim** and capped at 2000 characters; a selection spanning two messages
   or inside a streaming message is ignored.

---

## Tests

# self-dsh-plugins

自研 / 自维护 / fork 来的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（`dsh`）插件集合。
每个子目录是一个独立插件，通过 profile 的 `link:` 依赖挂到本机 DSH 上使用；**不走 npm 发布流程**。

## 插件清单

| 目录 | 包名 | 作用 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`dsh-auto-upgrade/`](./dsh-auto-upgrade) | `dsh-plugin-auto-upgrade` | dsh Web UI 自升级：检测 → 兼容性预检 → 非阻塞浮层 → 一键备份 / 安装 / 校验 / 重启 | 可用（真机升级链路待验证） |
| [`dsh-external-discuss/`](./dsh-external-discuss) | `dsh-plugin-external-discuss` | 把 DSH 会话一键送到外部模型（清言网页版）继续讨论 | 可用（需配套 Chrome 扩展；仅清言接通） |
| [`dsh-im-bridge-workspaces/`](./dsh-im-bridge-workspaces) | `@mhfire/dsh-im-bridge` | 企业微信智能机器人 ⇄ DSH Agent 桥接，本地 fork 增加多工作区 `/ws` 切换 | 可用（本机已接入 profile） |
| [`dsh-plugin-product-subagents/`](./dsh-plugin-product-subagents) | `dsh-plugin-product-subagents` | 把 Claude Code / Codex / 任意 ACP CLI 变成基于角色的 subagent（`0.2.0` 线可续接；`0.2.1+` 外部子代理为一次性） | 可用（DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.5` / `0.2.1-rc.1` 均通过一次性 profile 验收） |

---

## dsh-auto-upgrade

**来源：纯原创**（`package.json` 的 `repository` 已指向本仓库 `directory: dsh-auto-upgrade`）。
**改动：—**（没有上游）。

给 dsh 的 Web UI 加一个**自升级**入口：当天首次打开页面时自动检测 dsh 新版本与已装插件的兼容性，
用一个**不打断当前工作**的浮层提示；用户点「升级」后才走完整链路。

![设置页](./dsh-auto-upgrade/docs/screenshots/settings.png)

![浮层](./dsh-auto-upgrade/docs/screenshots/overlay.png)

### 它做什么

1. **当天首次打开自动检测**：宿主按本地日期幂等，同一天多标签页 / 刷新只真正检测一次。
2. **检测两件事**：npm 上的 dsh 新版本；已装插件对**目标版本**的兼容性（用官方 `evaluatePluginCompatibility`，不是自己写范围匹配）。
3. **不打断工作的浮层**：右下角卡片，只占自己的位置；可「稍后」「不再提示」。
4. **点升级才动手**：会话门禁 → 插件门禁 → 备份 `~/.dsh` → 停服 → `npm install -g` → 对版 + 组合冒烟 → 重启交接。
5. **回滚与重启**：重装指定旧版本；或只重启服务。设置页还有本机体检、插件兼容表、升级 / 重启日志。

### 关键设计

- **双面插件，无构建步骤**：宿主半边 `lib/index.js` 用 cordis 注册 `/api/dsh-auto-upgrade/*` 路由族；
  浏览器半边 `lib/client.js` 手写并包在 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})` 里，注册
  `shell.overlay` 浮层与 `settings.section` 设置页。
- **变更必须脱离进程**：`npm install -g` 覆盖的正是宿主此刻在运行的那棵树，而「停服」就是杀掉宿主自己。
  所以宿主只做「门禁 → 备份 → 落 payload → fork detached helper → `exit 0`」，停服 / 安装 / 对版 / 冒烟 / 拉起
  都在生成的 POSIX sh helper 里。
- **故意不声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peerDependencies**：否则升级之后，平台闸门会把「负责升级 dsh 的插件」
  自己判成不兼容（自锁）。本包只声明 `react`（浏览器半边需要）。
- **安全边界**：路由族能读 npm、重写全局安装树、覆盖 `~/.dsh`、结束本进程，所以一律 loopback-only
  （以 socket 地址为准，不信任 `X-Forwarded-For`），并且**有副作用的一律 POST**。
- **UI 吃 dsh 的设计 token**：字体 `--dsw-font-*`、圆角 `--dsw-radius-*`、语义色 `--dsw-alias-state-*`，
  数值逐条对齐官方实现。详见包内 README 的「UI 风格契约」。

### 两条门禁（默认策略）

| 情况 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 有会话正在执行 | `409`，前端弹警告；用户确认后可带 `force` 继续（**仅警告**） |
| 目标版本与已装插件不兼容 | `409`，**拒绝升级且不可绕过**——先升级 / 移除那个插件，或为它写精确版本豁免 |

> 豁免是按「插件@版本 → dsh 版本」精确匹配的：为 `0.2.0-rc.2` 写的豁免，升级到别的版本时**自动失效**，
> 那个插件会立刻出现在「不兼容」里。这正是本插件要提前告诉你的信息。

### 已知限制（诚实清单）

- **真机的安装 / 升级 / 重启链路尚未执行**（属于需要用户点头的闸门）；只读半边与门禁已在真机验证。
- 只支持 macOS / Linux：helper 是 POSIX sh 脚本。
- `POST /plugins/action`（写豁免 / 禁用插件）尚未接线，如实返回 `501`；`GET /notes` 已实现。
- 暂不做「静默自动升级」：`policy.mode` 只接受 `notify`。

### 文档

- [设计：接口清单 + 数据流图 + 拍板结论](./dsh-auto-upgrade/docs/design/dsh-auto-upgrade-T1.md)
- [验收报告：逐条证据 + 明确没验证什么](./dsh-auto-upgrade/docs/acceptance/dsh-auto-upgrade-acceptance.md)
- 面向 agent 的工作约定：[`docs/plugins/dsh-auto-upgrade.md`](./docs/plugins/dsh-auto-upgrade.md)

## dsh-external-discuss

**来源：纯原创**。**改动：—**（没有上游）。

在助手消息操作栏（复制 / 反馈 / 新对话分支 / 用量 / 时间那一条）多出一个图标按钮，点开弹层选择投递目标：

| 目标 | 状态 | 行为 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 清言（`chatglm.cn`） | ✅ 可用 | 在已登录的清言页新建对话 → 按 DSH 会话标题重命名 → 粘贴正文 → 发送 |
| 千问 / DeepSeek | ⏸ 占位 | 显示「即将支持」，不可点 |

链路：页面按钮 → `GET /api/dsh-external-discuss/payload?sessionId=…`（宿主取正文与标题，
取自 `session.deriveMessages()` 的会话投影，不是抓页面 DOM）→ `window.postMessage` →
配套 Chrome 扩展转发到清言标签页 → 回执逐级回投 → 按钮下方显示结果。

安装分两步：插件（`dsh plugin --profile web add`，装完重启 dsh web）+ Chrome 扩展
（`chrome://extensions` → 开发者模式 → 加载已解压的扩展程序 → 选 `extension/`，装完**刷新 DSH 页面**）。
清言是第三方页面，改版会让选择器失效——候选文本集中在 `extension/qingyan-content.js` 顶部的 `CONFIG` 里。
详见 [包内 README](./dsh-external-discuss/README.md) 与 [`docs/plugins/dsh-external-discuss.md`](./docs/plugins/dsh-external-discuss.md)。

## dsh-im-bridge-workspaces

**来源：fork** 自 npm 包 `@mhfire/dsh-im-bridge@0.4.4`（本地 fork 版本 `0.4.4-ws.1`），
上游原版说明见 [README.upstream.md](./dsh-im-bridge-workspaces/README.upstream.md)。

**改了什么：** 新增**工作区列表与 `/ws` 切换**（`/ws`、`/ws <序号|title|路径|id>`、`/ws reset`、

这是本仓库**唯一需要构建**的插件（`src/` → `lib/`，`pnpm run build`）。
详见 [包内 README](./dsh-im-bridge-workspaces/README.md) 与
[`docs/plugins/dsh-im-bridge-workspaces.md`](./docs/plugins/dsh-im-bridge-workspaces.md)。

## dsh-plugin-product-subagents

**来源：fork** 自 GitHub `shaokeyibb/dsh-plugin-product-subagents` v0.4.0，
commit `e5a002db3b8d6df984fdb5e704e9321dca1723cd`，MIT。

**改了什么（适配 DSH `0.2.x`，业务代码未改）：**

- 扩展 `peerDependencies` / `dsh.compatibility.dsh` 的 DSH 版本范围，补 `dshReleases` verdict
  （`0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.1`，**均有一次性 profile 验收背书**：install · compose · start · uninstall）；
- 版本 `0.4.0 → 0.4.1`，同步 `CHANGELOG.md` / `docs/COMPATIBILITY.md` / `README.md` + `README.zh.md`；
- 并入本仓库统一管理（**已删除其内层 `.git`**，上游历史见上述 commit）。

> 为什么只改声明：0.4.0 在 `0.2.x` 上其实已能正常运行，缺的只是声明——
> DSH 启动时按插件**自己声明的** peer 范围判兼容，没覆盖就跳过该 bundle（表现为「插件莫名其妙没加载」）。
> ⚠️ prerelease 陷阱：`^0.2.0-rc.2` **不覆盖** `0.2.1-rc.1`，每条 `0.2.x` 线都要单独写一个锚点。

它把 Claude Code / Codex / 任意 ACP CLI 变成基于角色的可续接 subagent：一次性同步或异步可续接、
持久会话恢复、每角色 product 权限、受**权限天花板**约束的委派、声明式角色库（`roles/*.json`）。
详见 [英文 README](./dsh-plugin-product-subagents/README.md) / [中文 README](./dsh-plugin-product-subagents/README.zh.md) /
[`docs/plugins/dsh-plugin-product-subagents.md`](./docs/plugins/dsh-plugin-product-subagents.md)。

## 环境要求

| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.0-rc.2`（本机实测版本）；插件各自声明兼容范围，见上 |
| Node | `v24.21.0`（各插件 `engines` 不一，`dsh-auto-upgrade` / `dsh-external-discuss` 要求 `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0`，`dsh-plugin-product-subagents` 要求 `>=18`） |
| 包管理器 | **pnpm**（本仓库与全局约定一律 pnpm，禁 npm / yarn / bun / npx；详见 [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) 强制规定 2） |
| 产品 CLI | `dsh-plugin-product-subagents` 至少需要 `claude` / `codex` / 任一 ACP CLI 之一（如本机的 `opencode`） |
| shell | macOS 自带 bash 3.2（脚本已按 3.2 写） |

## 安装 / 卸载

```sh
# 安装（<目录> 用仓库内的目录名，路径按实际 clone 位置调整）
dsh plugin --profile web add /Users/gubin/workspace/self-dsh-plugins/<目录>

# 卸载
dsh plugin --profile web remove <包名>
```

- `add` 时若插件 `package.json` 声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，会自动挂上 patch 层，**无需手改**
  `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`。
- 本机 profile 是 `patchReload: live`：装完 / 改完通常**不用重启**，刷新页面即可。
  （`dsh-external-discuss` 与 `dsh-im-bridge-workspaces` 的宿主半边在冷启动装配，按各自 README 的说明处理。）
- `dsh plugin` 的 profile 目录在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`；`dependencies` 用 `link:` 指向本仓库子目录。
- ⚠️ **改了 `link:` 目标路径后，必须在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web` 跑一次 `pnpm install`**，否则软链悬空、
  插件加载失败。

## 验证

```sh
# 跑 4 个插件的测试 / check / typecheck（缺 node_modules 的插件会明确跳过，不算失败）
scripts/pipeline/check-all.sh
scripts/pipeline/check-all.sh dsh-auto-upgrade dsh-plugin-product-subagents   # 只跑指定插件

# 在一次性 $DSH_HOME 里验证插件能被 profile 正确安装 + 组合（绝不触碰真实 ~/.dsh）
scripts/pipeline/install-check.sh
scripts/pipeline/install-check.sh dsh-plugin-product-subagents
```

- **本仓库的「交付物」不是线上服务，而是「插件被本机 DSH profile 正确装配」**——对应 `install-check.sh`，
  它每个插件新建一个 `mktemp -d` 的 `DSH_HOME`，`pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@<当前版本> plugin --profile headless add <插件>`
  后用 `--dump-config` 校验，装完即删。
- ⚠️ **`dsh-im-bridge-workspaces` 无法独立 `pnpm install`**（干净 checkout 里必然失败，原因见
  [issue #3](https://github.com/guraul/self-dsh-plugins/issues/3)：其 `peerDependencies` 用 `*` 会解析到陈旧的
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session@0.0.1-rc.1`，后者依赖未发布的内部包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-type-meta`）。
  所以它**不进 `check-all.sh` 的常规测试路径**，CI 里也**只做 `node --check` 语法门禁**并打印跳过原因；
  完整校验走 `scripts/pipeline/install-check.sh dsh-im-bridge-workspaces`（一次性 DSH profile 里装配）。
- 只读状态一览：`scripts/pipeline/status.sh`。
- CI（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）只跑测试 + `node --check`，**零部署步骤**；`dsh-im-bridge-workspaces`
  那一项 `install: false`，即跳过安装 / 测试 / typecheck，只跑语法门禁。
